Definition (EN): to manage with something inadequate
Quote from Episode: But we just make do.
台词翻译: 但我们只能将就着过。
Example Sentence: With a third of the budget they just make do.
例句翻译: 预算只有三分之一，只能将就。
Usage Note: make do with（某物）＝凑合用。make do without=没有也凑合过。

Definition (EN): to learn how to do something
Quote from Episode: getting the hang of it
台词翻译: 我们年轻老师还在摸索门道。
Example Sentence: It took me a month to get the hang of the reporting software.
例句翻译: 我花了一个月才摸熟那套报表软件。
Usage Note: 名词 the hang of sth＝诀窍（近义 knack）。

Definition (EN): to survive an ordeal
释义（中文）: 活着出来；总算挺过来了
Quote from Episode: come out alive.
台词翻译: 我当老师就是为了确保学生能活着走出来。
Example Sentence: Two hundred candidates came out of the interview alive.
例句翻译: 两百个候选人总算面完活下来了。
Usage Note: 夸张说法，表示过程摧残但人挺住了。

Definition (EN): to feel in control and handling things well
释义（中文）: 得心应手；一切尽在掌握
Quote from Episode: I finally feel on top of things.
台词翻译: 我终于觉得一切尽在掌握了。
Example Sentence: After the system upgrade she felt on top of things again.
例句翻译: 系统升级后她又一次觉得尽在掌握。
Usage Note: 反义 feel out of depth（力不从心）。on top of 还可指「在…之上」。

Definition (EN): an alternative if the first option fails
Quote from Episode: And the rug was Plan B?!
台词翻译: 所以地毯是 B 计划？！
Example Sentence: If the budget won't stretch, Plan B is a phased rollout.
例句翻译: 预算不够的话，B 方案是分阶段上线。
Usage Note: 日常口语＝退路。正式商务语境常见。

Definition (EN): a place that reduces anxiety
Quote from Episode: calming space
台词翻译: 地毯对孩子来说就像一个让人平静的地方。
Example Sentence: A quiet room works as a calming space during meltdown.
例句翻译: 崩溃期一个安静的房间能起到让人平静的作用。
Usage Note: 空间/场所描述的高频组合，职场谈办公环境也用。

Definition (EN): a devout, upright woman
释义（中文）: 上帝的女人；虔诚正直的女人
Quote from Episode: I'm Barbara Howard, woman of God.
台词翻译: 我是 Barbara Howard，上帝的女人。
Example Sentence: She'd probably describe herself as a woman of God.
例句翻译: 她大概会自称是上帝的女人。
Usage Note: 宗教圈的自我介绍；常带自嘲意味。

Definition (EN): one behind another in a line
Quote from Episode: Out in the hallway in a single file.
台词翻译: 在走廊里排成单行。
Example Sentence: Line up single file and follow the teacher.
例句翻译: 排成一列跟着老师走。
Usage Note: 美国学校常用；英国多说 in a line。

Definition (EN): an expert at a hands-on tool
Quote from Episode: a wizard with a glue gun
台词翻译: 用热熔胶枪的高手。
Example Sentence: He's a wizard with Excel; ask him anything.
例句翻译: Excel 用得问他就行，他是个高手。
Usage Note: 结构：a wizard with sth。也可说 a whiz at／a guru at。

Definition (EN): the teacher's comment on a school report
Quote from Episode: She wrote in my report card note
台词翻译: 她在我的成绩单评语里写道……
Example Sentence: His report card note said 'a joy to teach'.
例句翻译: 他的成绩单评语写着「教起来很轻松」。
Usage Note: 美式；英式说 school report。报告单本身叫 report card。

Definition (EN): too attached and reluctant to leave
Quote from Episode: A bit clingy.
台词翻译: 有点黏人。
Example Sentence: New joiners can come across as clingy in week one.
例句翻译: 新人第一周容易显得不合群、黏人。
Usage Note: 带负面评价。反义 independent。cling to=紧抓不放。

Definition (EN): a person who is very entertaining
Quote from Episode: She was a hoot.
台词翻译: 她可太有意思了。
Example Sentence: Everyone says Marcus is a hoot to work with.
例句翻译: 大家都说跟 Marcus 共事特别有意思。
Usage Note: 20 世纪早期指笑点，现多用于夸人风趣。

Definition (EN): to be routed to the junk folder
Quote from Episode: It must have gone to spam.
台词翻译: 肯定进垃圾箱了。
Example Sentence: Your filters sent the offer to spam again.
例句翻译: 过滤器又把那份录用通知扔进垃圾箱了。
Usage Note: 也作 end up in the spam folder。名词 spam folder。

Definition (EN): a bond formed through shared hardship
释义（中文）: 创伤联结；共患难建立的情谊
Quote from Episode: So trauma bonding, I guess?
台词翻译: 所以算是创伤联结吧？
Example Sentence: Nine people on the same team for two years builds trauma bonding.
例句翻译: 同队共事两年会形成一种共患难的默契。
Usage Note: 心理学概念，本指被虐待后产生的依恋；职场泛指一起扛过事的关系。

Definition (EN): a nickname expressing affection
Quote from Episode: it's like a term of endearment
台词翻译: 那算是一种昵称。
Example Sentence: "Big man" is how his crew uses it as a term of endearment.
例句翻译: 「大哥」是他队友的昵称。
Usage Note: 与 insult（侮辱）相对——同一个词语境不同含义完全不同。

Definition (EN): a hundred dollars
Quote from Episode: $100, known as a C-note.
台词翻译: 一百美元，大写叫 a C-note。
Example Sentence: The deposit was two C-notes and he still walked away.
例句翻译: 押金是两个 C-note（大写一百），他还是走了。
Usage Note: 大写 C 是罗马数字 100。连字＝grand（千美元）。

Definition (EN): to apply a veneer of class to something shabby
Quote from Episode: you can't class up a rug
台词翻译: 地毯是贴不了金的。
Example Sentence: You cannot class up a cracked vinyl floor with a rug.
例句翻译: 一块开裂的地胶盖块毯子也装不出体面。
Usage Note: 来自 class 作动词＝「使显得高级」。带轻蔑。

Definition (EN): any publicity, even negative, helps
Quote from Episode: No press is bad press, Barb.
台词翻译: 没有新闻才是坏新闻，Barb。
Example Sentence: Local papers are running with it — no press is bad press.
例句翻译: 本地报纸都在炒这事——没新闻才是坏新闻。
Usage Note: 源自 press agent 行业。常用反讽，语境多为批评。

Definition (EN): continuing to do very well
Quote from Episode: Still thriving.
台词翻译: 看看梅尔·吉布森，照样滋润。
Example Sentence: The brand weathered three scandals and is still thriving.
例句翻译: 这品牌扛了三次丑闻，照样活得好好的。
Usage Note: 此处是讽刺。反义 struggling（艰难维持）。

Definition (EN): not given enough money to work
Quote from Episode: underfunded, poorly managed
台词翻译: 经费不足、管理不善的公立学校
Example Sentence: Underfunded programmes always cut the training budget first.
例句翻译: 经费不足的项目总是先砍培训预算。
Usage Note: 常与 understaffed、oversubscribed 连用。

Definition (EN): stay alert behind you
Quote from Episode: mind my six this morning.
台词翻译: 今早有个学生让我注意身后。
Example Sentence: On a crowded subway, mind your six.
例句翻译: 挤地铁时留意身后。
Usage Note: six＝六点钟方向（背后）。军队／警察俚语，日常是玩笑。

Definition (EN): to have almost no effect
释义（中文）: 作用跟…差不多（等于没用）
Quote from Episode: My support was gonna do about as much
台词翻译: 我的支持作用跟那个五号文胸差不多。
Example Sentence: A polite email will do about as much as a raised eyebrow.
例句翻译: 一封客气的邮件效果跟挑眉差不多。
Usage Note: 否定语境常接无用的东西，表示「聊胜于无也没有」。

Definition (EN): good at solving problems creatively
Quote from Episode: Melissa is resourceful, capable.
台词翻译: Melissa 很有办法，能干。
Example Sentence: He was resourceful enough to build it from spare parts.
例句翻译: 他有办法用零件把它拼出来。
Usage Note: 形容词来自 resource；职场评价高频，比 smart 更褒义。

Definition (EN): to endure until the end
Quote from Episode: stick it out longer than two years?
台词翻译: 你们怎么都撑不过两年？
Example Sentence: The first quarter is brutal; most people can't stick it out.
例句翻译: 第一个季度很熬，多数人撑不下来。
Usage Note: stick it out＝硬撑完。反义 quit。

Definition (EN): the rate at which staff leave and are replaced
Quote from Episode: More turnovers than a bakery.
台词翻译: 人员流动比面包店还勤。
Example Sentence: Their turnover is double the industry average.
例句翻译: 他们的流动率是行业均值的两倍。
Usage Note: 此处双关 turnover＝面团翻面／烤制。HR 通用词。

Definition (EN): inappropriate; crossing a line
Quote from Episode: out of line
台词翻译: Schwartz 老师做得不合适。
Example Sentence: His remarks were out of line for a staff meeting.
例句翻译: 他那番话在员工会上不合适。
Usage Note: 反义 in line。职场批评常用。

Definition (EN): to face more opponents than you
Quote from Episode: I'm outnumbered in there.
台词翻译: 我在里面寡不敌众。
Example Sentence: In that meeting five directors outnumbered us.
例句翻译: 那次会上我们寡不敌众，对面五位董事。
Usage Note: 反义 outnumber（数量压过）。

Definition (EN): a distinctly original opinion (often ironic)
Quote from Episode: She has a unique take on her job.
台词翻译: 她对这份工作有独特的见解。
Example Sentence: His unique take on process management is mostly absence of process.
例句翻译: 他对流程管理的独特见解，基本等于没有流程。
Usage Note: take＝看法。职场里 unique 常是反话，等于「有问题」。

Definition (EN): clothing valued for usefulness over style
释义（中文）: 功能性时尚（只求能穿不讲好看）
Quote from Episode: It's called functional fashion.
台词翻译: 这叫功能性时尚。
Example Sentence: Teachers live in functional fashion.
例句翻译: 老师们穿的都是能穿就行。
Usage Note: 自嘲式说法，职场里也可泛指「够用就行」。

Definition (EN): a required interval before something can happen
Quote from Episode: a five-day waiting period
台词翻译: 五天的等待期
Example Sentence: There's a two-week waiting period before you're eligible.
例句翻译: 要等两周才具备资格。
Usage Note: HR/保险高频词，比 waiting list 精确。

Definition (EN): to make sure a rule is obeyed
Quote from Episode: if we're not gonna enforce it?
台词翻译: 要是我们不打算执行呢？
Example Sentence: A policy nobody enforces is not a policy.
例句翻译: 没人执行的制度等于不存在。
Usage Note: 职场高频：制度存在但 enforce 不到位是最常见的抱怨。反义违抗。

Definition (EN): present at an event
Quote from Episode: Yesterday, everybody was in attendance
台词翻译: 昨天所有人都到场了
Example Sentence: Attendance is compulsory for all staff.
例句翻译: 所有员工必须出席。
Usage Note: 正式语体，比 here 一词正式。动词 attend。

Definition (EN): to exhaust or overwhelm you with work
Quote from Episode: double class is kicking my ass.
台词翻译: 这个连堂课快把我累死了
Example Sentence: The end-of-quarter workload is kicking my ass.
例句翻译: 季末的工作量快把我压垮了。
Usage Note: 粗俗但极常用。ass 在此不是屁股。

Definition (EN): to have not yet completed your share of work
Quote from Episode: I'm behind on lesson plans
台词翻译: 我的教案还没做完。
Example Sentence: I'm behind on my reviews and it's only Tuesday.
例句翻译: 我的评审还欠着，才周二呢。
Usage Note: 职场高频。可接具体任务，也可接进度。

Definition (EN): to reach the current level after falling behind
Quote from Episode: I'm doing LEGO day to catch up.
台词翻译: 我办乐高日来赶进度。
Example Sentence: We spent the morning catching up on the backlog.
例句翻译: 我们用一上午赶积压的进度。
Usage Note: 职场搭配 catch up on work / on the backlog；on 后面才接内容。

Definition (EN): financial backing in exchange for publicity
Quote from Episode: LEGO owes me a sponsorship already
台词翻译: 乐高欠我一份赞助了。
Example Sentence: They rejected the sponsorship budget twice.
例句翻译: 赞助预算他们拒了两次。
Usage Note: 动词 sponsor。对比 donate（无商业回报的捐赠）。

Definition (EN): a tank of water for sensory-deprivation relaxation
Quote from Episode: than my at-home float tank
台词翻译: 比我家那个漂浮缸还强烈
Example Sentence: She floated for an hour in the tank.
例句翻译: 她在缸里漂了一个小时。
Usage Note: 也叫 sensory deprivation tank；动词 float＝漂浮。

Definition (EN): to accept or overlook wrongdoing
Quote from Episode: I don't condone violence
台词翻译: 我不纵容暴力。
Example Sentence: The school won't condone harassment.
例句翻译: 学校不会纵容骚扰行为。
Usage Note: 强否定意义，常用于政策声明。condone＝容忍，condemn＝谴责，别混。

Definition (EN): a performance so vivid it feels real
Quote from Episode: a book come to life
台词翻译: 一本活过来的书
Example Sentence: The staging made it a book come to life.
例句翻译: 这套舞台让它成了一本活过来的书。
Usage Note: 固定搭配，也说 bring sth to life。

Definition (EN): to have missed something obvious that everyone else caught
释义（中文）: （好资源）一直没人发现；被集体忽略
Quote from Episode: is so slept on.
台词翻译: 一直被无视了。
Example Sentence: This restaurant has been slept on for years.
例句翻译: 这家馆子被低估了好几年。
Usage Note: 意思是「没注意到、没当回事」，不是「注意到」。常说 the market slept on the news（市场对这条消息毫无反应）。近义：overlook, ignore, miss。注意与 sleep on it（考虑一晚再定）区分。

Definition (EN): to dismiss as worthless or hopeless
Quote from Episode: People write off this area
台词翻译: 人们就把这个地方一笔带过
Example Sentence: Don't write off the proposal before you've read it.
例句翻译: 没看完之前别就把这份提案否掉。
Usage Note: 职场常用：write off a risk / an idea。写坏���用 write off（核销）。

Definition (EN): an area with little access to affordable food
释义（中文）: 食品荒漠（缺乏食品供应的城区）
Quote from Episode: People write off this area
台词翻译: 人们就把这个地区一笔带过
Example Sentence: Two new supermarkets turned a food desert into a food oasis.
例句翻译: 两家新超市把食品荒漠变成了食品绿洲。
Usage Note: 城市政策术语；对比 food oasis（食品绿洲）。

Definition (EN): to prepare for work
Quote from Episode: Prepping.
台词翻译: 备课中。
Example Sentence: She's prepping for parent-teacher conferences all week.
例句翻译: 她整周都在准备家长会。
Usage Note: 口语缩写 prep。prepare 的宾语常被省略。

Definition (EN): a statement that one accepts blame for a crime
Quote from Episode: we apprehended three individuals and placed them into custody
台词翻译: 这不是认罪。
Example Sentence: His signed confession was read as an admission of guilt.
例句翻译: 他签字的口供被当作了认罪。
Usage Note: 法律固定搭配；guiltless / not guilty 才是无罪。

Definition (EN): to catch or arrest someone officially
Quote from Episode: we apprehended three individuals and placed them into custody
台词翻译: 我们逮捕了三名嫌疑人并将其收押。
Example Sentence: Two men were apprehended after the raid.
例句翻译: 突袭后有两名男子被捕。
Usage Note: 常用被动式 be apprehended by；名词 apprehension 指「理解」时读 /ˌæprɪˈhenʃən/。

Definition (EN): held by police, not yet sentenced
Quote from Episode: One suspect in custody.
台词翻译: 一名嫌疑人已收押。
Example Sentence: He's been in custody since March.
例句翻译: 他自三月起一直被羁押。
Usage Note: take someone into custody 为「逮捕」；in prison 指已服刑。

Definition (EN): to reduce something noticeably
释义（中文）: 给…造成打击；使…明显下降
Quote from Episode: put this big a dent in the local drug trade
台词翻译: 对本地毒品交易造成这么大冲击。
Example Sentence: The new cameras put a real dent in speeding.
例句翻译: 新摄像头让超速明显减少。
Usage Note: 也说 make a dent in；big a dent 为强调语气。

Definition (EN): observing an experienced person at work
Quote from Episode: I'll take you on a ride-along
台词翻译: 我带你出一次任务。
Example Sentence: He did a few ride-alongs before carrying a weapon.
例句翻译: 在配枪前他先随行观摩过几次。
Usage Note: 警务与军队用语；搭配 go on a ride-along。

Definition (EN): false or imitation, as a prefix
Quote from Episode: That faux-Lalique vase I picked up at the Super-Swap
台词翻译: 那是我在二手店淘的仿拉利克花瓶。
Example Sentence: The counter was faux-marble.
例句翻译: 台面是仿大理石的。
Usage Note: 读 /foʊ/，不读 /fjuː/；常见 faux-leather、faux-fur。

Definition (EN): to reach a set savings minimum
Quote from Episode: I met my reserve
台词翻译: 我达到了底线。
Example Sentence: Few households have savings to meet their reserve.
例句翻译: 很少有家庭的储蓄能达到自定的储备线。
Usage Note: 经济与保险用语；近义 break even。

Definition (EN): unable to be treated by surgery
Quote from Episode: Inoperable.
台词翻译: 无法手术。
Example Sentence: The tumour is inoperable, so chemo is the only option.
例句翻译: 肿瘤无法手术，化疗是唯一选择。
Usage Note: 反义 operable；名词 inoperability。

Definition (EN): the most favourable possible outcome
Quote from Episode: Best-case scenario, with chemo, I'll live maybe another couple years.
台词翻译: 最理想的情况下，加上化疗我大概还能活两三年。
Example Sentence: Even in the best-case scenario it takes a year.
例句翻译: 即便最理想也要一年。
Usage Note: 对应 worst-case scenario；正式写作常用。

Definition (EN): lacking enough staff to work properly
Quote from Episode: I'm shorthanded, Walter.
台词翻译: 沃尔特，我这儿正缺人。
Example Sentence: We're shorthanded; please reschedule.
例句翻译: 我们人手不足，请改期。
Usage Note: 职场书面语，口语说 understaffed。

Definition (EN): to clean a surface with a damp cloth
Quote from Episode: I need you to do some wipe-downs.
台词翻译: 我需要你去做一些擦拭。
Example Sentence: The checklist ends with a wipe-down of the counter.
例句翻译: 清单最后一项是擦拭台面。
Usage Note: 服务业常用，口语拼作 wipe down；名词 wipe-down。

Definition (EN): official permission to go ahead
Quote from Episode: Got the green light.
台词翻译: 已获批准。
Example Sentence: The board gave the plan the green light.
例句翻译: 董事会批准了这个方案。
Usage Note: give / get the green light；反义 red light；注意冠词 the。

Definition (EN): said to acknowledge a message is understood
Quote from Episode: Copy that.
台词翻译: 收到。
Example Sentence: Radio check, copy that.
例句翻译: 通讯测试，收到。
Usage Note: 无线电确认用语，口语常缩为 copy。

Definition (EN): to surrender oneself to police
Quote from Episode: Either that or I turn you in.
台词翻译: 要么合伙，要么我把你交出去。
Example Sentence: He turned himself in after three days.
例句翻译: 三天后他去自首了。
Usage Note: 此处重音落在 in；「交作业」的 turn in 重音在 turn。

Definition (EN): to develop into or come to amount to
Quote from Episode: I never expected you to amount to much
台词翻译: 我从没指望你能有什么出息。
Example Sentence: He started as a dishwasher and ended up running the kitchen.
例句翻译: 他从洗碗工做起，最后管起了后厨。
Usage Note: amount to nothing 即「没出息」；带轻微失望意味。

Definition (EN): to tell someone rudely to go away
Quote from Episode: You ain't Welcome Back Kotter, so step off.
台词翻译: 你那套《回到科特威尔》收起来吧，走开。
Example Sentence: I said I'm not interested. Step off.
例句翻译: 我说没兴趣，走开。
Usage Note: 带轻蔑，不是中性的 step off the gas。

Definition (EN): a very brief remark, often ironic
释义（中文）: 简短发言；（反讽）三言两语
Quote from Episode: Short speech.
台词翻译: 简短发言。
Example Sentence: He gave his acceptance as a two-line speech.
例句翻译: 他用两句话作了个简短发言。
Usage Note: 单独说 short speech 常带「我说完了，就这些」的不耐烦。

Definition (EN): to evaluate the quality of someone's work
Quote from Episode: I could critique it for you
台词翻译: 我可以给你点评。
Example Sentence: She critiqued the draft and returned it an hour later.
例句翻译: 她批评了一遍草稿，一小时后还回来。
Usage Note: 及物用法 critique something；也可作名词。

Definition (EN): someone unable to cope, said lightly
Quote from Episode: You're gonna be a complete basket case.
台词翻译: 到时候你整个人都要崩了。
Example Sentence: By finals he was a total basket case.
例句翻译: 期末他整个人都是崩的。
Usage Note: 源自1918年流感时的旧分类标签；比 nervous wreck 更夸张。

Definition (EN): emotional upheaval in middle age
Quote from Episode: So it's mid-life crisis.
台词翻译: 所以是中年危机呗。
Example Sentence: The novel is about a mid-life crisis.
例句翻译: 这部小说写的是中年危机。
Usage Note: 形容词 mid-life；也常说 male mid-life crisis。

Definition (EN): the highlight of a series
Quote from Episode: But the pièce de résistance: a round bottom boiling flask.
台词翻译: 但压轴的是圆底烧瓶。
Example Sentence: The final lecture was the pièce de résistance.
例句翻译: 最后那堂课是压轴。
Usage Note: 法语借词，字面「抵抗之物」；重音在 ré。

Definition (EN): substances added to dilute a product
Quote from Episode: No adulterants.
台词翻译: 不加掺杂物。
Example Sentence: The lab closed for adding adulterants.
例句翻译: 那家实验室因掺杂物被查封。
Usage Note: 食品与药品监管用语；动词 adulterate。

Definition (EN): a distinctive personal touch
Quote from Episode: chili P is my signature
台词翻译: 红椒粉是我的招牌。
Example Sentence: The extra garlic is her signature.
例句翻译: 多加蒜是她的招牌。
Usage Note: 此处是「个人风格」义，不是「签名」。

Definition (EN): don't take risks in your own home turf
释义（中文）: 别在自己地盘上干有风险的事
Quote from Episode: I don't shit where I eat.
台词翻译: 我不干那种在自己家搞事的事。
Example Sentence: Don't shit where you eat—keep the books clean.
例句翻译: 别在自己地盘上冒险，账目要干净。
Usage Note: 源自工程与军队俚语；粗俗但常见的商业警句。

Definition (EN): deliberately vague to avoid the question
Quote from Episode: Be all evasive.
台词翻译: 就躲躲藏藏的。
Example Sentence: His answer was evasive.
例句翻译: 他的回答含糊其辞。
Usage Note: 动词 evade；商务与法律常用。

Definition (EN): a remote rural area
Quote from Episode: drive way out in the boonies
台词翻译: 开到特别偏的乡下。
Example Sentence: They bought a place in the boonies.
例句翻译: 他们在荒郊买了房子。
Usage Note: 美式口语，正式用 remote countryside。

Definition (EN): does not make sense to me
Quote from Episode: It doesn't compute.
台词翻译: 就是说不通。
Example Sentence: The numbers add up but the story doesn't compute.
例句翻译: 数字对得上，但事说不通。
Usage Note: 用计算比喻思维，1960年代起流行。

Definition (EN): it is getting late; hurry up
Quote from Episode: Daylight's burning.
台词翻译: 天都快黑了。
Example Sentence: Daylight's burning—pack up.
例句翻译: 天快黑了，收东西。
Usage Note: 原指伐木工收工；现等于 time is running out。

Definition (EN): something very good or impressive
Quote from Episode: That'd be the bomb.
台词翻译: 那可太酷了。
Example Sentence: Her presentation was the bomb.
例句翻译: 她的演讲太棒了。
Usage Note: 1990年代美式俚语，略显老派。

Definition (EN): completely flat; said humorously
Quote from Episode: you're flat as a washboard
台词翻译: 你胸平得跟搓板一样。
Example Sentence: The bread came out flat as a washboard.
例句翻译: 面包烤得跟搓板一样。
Usage Note: 双关，也用来形容毫无起伏。

Definition (EN): the weapon or bag you normally carry
Quote from Episode: It's my daily carry, okay?
台词翻译: 这是我平时随身带的。
Example Sentence: He only carries one knife—his daily carry.
例句翻译: 他只带一把刀，那就是他的随身装备。
Usage Note: 源自 EDC（everyday carry）文化。

Definition (EN): to bring enough force to finish the job
释义（中文）: 带上足够的家伙；备足筹码
Quote from Episode: If you're gonna bring a gun, you gotta bring enough gun.
台词翻译: 你要带枪就得带够。
Example Sentence: He brought enough gun to outlast them.
例句翻译: 他备足了火力撑过他们。
Usage Note: gun 为「实力」比喻，源自枪械。

Definition (EN): a short speech praising someone with a raised glass
Quote from Episode: A little toast to my brother-in-law.
台词翻译: 为我姐夫敬一杯。
Example Sentence: He raised his glass for a toast.
例句翻译: 他举杯祝酒。
Usage Note: make / propose a toast。

Definition (EN): a simile for being slow-witted
Quote from Episode: you got a brain the size of Wisconsin
台词翻译: 你脑子就威斯康星州那么大。
Example Sentence: He has a brain the size of a pea.
例句翻译: 他脑子只有豌豆大。
Usage Note: 英语里常见的「笨蛋」谚语模式。

Definition (EN): good-hearted despite flaws
Quote from Episode: your heart's in the right place
台词翻译: 你这人心眼儿不坏。
Example Sentence: He's clumsy but his heart's in the right place.
例句翻译: 他笨手笨脚但心眼不坏。
Usage Note: 近义 have good intentions；反义 have a cold heart。

Definition (EN): judging by the current pace
Quote from Episode: At this rate, in 50 or 60 years, you'll be rich.
台词翻译: 照这个速度五六十年你就富了。
Example Sentence: At this rate we'll miss the deadline.
例句翻译: 照这样我们赶不上期限。
Usage Note: 后接 will / won't 结果。

Definition (EN): provided the terms are favourable
Quote from Episode: if the price is right
台词翻译: 价钱合适的话
Example Sentence: We'll move if the price is right.
例句翻译: 价钱合适我们就搬。
Usage Note: 谈判套话，不真的只谈价钱。

Definition (EN): to be self-righteous and uptight
Quote from Episode: giant stick up his ass
台词翻译: 翘得老高
Example Sentence: He's all sticks-up-his-ass about paperwork.
例句翻译: 他对文件手续一本正经得不得了。
Usage Note: 动词 stick it up your ass 意为「别那么拘谨」，与形容词相反。

Definition (EN): to suddenly turn to wrongdoing
Quote from Episode: he's just gonna break bad?
台词翻译: 他就突然要堕入歧途？
Example Sentence: Two good neighbourhoods broke bad in a decade.
例句翻译: 两个好社区十年里就堕落了。
Usage Note: 剧名由此而来；区别 break down（出故障）。

Definition (EN): to inform on someone
Quote from Episode: He thinks maybe you dimed on him.
台词翻译: 他觉得是你把他卖了。
Example Sentence: Nobody dimed on anyone.
例句翻译: 没人出卖谁。
Usage Note: 近义 rat on someone；与名词 dime（角币）无关。

Definition (EN): an offensive word for an informer
Quote from Episode: You ratasnitch motherfucker!
台词翻译: 你这个告密的混蛋！
Example Sentence: He thought his partner was a ratasnitch.
例句翻译: 他以为搭档是告密的。
Usage Note: 近义 snitch、informant；带强烈侮辱色彩。

Definition (EN): there is no time to waste; hurry
Quote from Episode: We ain't got all day.
台词翻译: 我们没那么多时间。
Example Sentence: Ain't got all day, the train leaves in twenty.
例句翻译: 没时间了，车二十分钟后开。
Usage Note: 正式说法 hurry up；ain't 为非标准缩合。

Definition (EN): to exclude from information or feelings
Quote from Episode: shut me out
台词翻译: 把我甩在外面
Example Sentence: He shut her out after the second year.
例句翻译: 他大二之后就把她排除在外了。
Usage Note: shut someone out of something。

Definition (EN): with extra force and determination
Quote from Episode: With a vengeance.
台词翻译: 加倍奉还。
Example Sentence: He returned to the ring with a vengeance.
例句翻译: 他重返拳坛，杀气十足。
Usage Note: 来自圣经「报复」意象；加强语气。

Definition (EN): to be released on bond
Quote from Episode: Made bail this morning.
台词翻译: 今天早上保释了。
Example Sentence: He made bail after his arraignment.
例句翻译: 他在传讯后获得保释。
Usage Note: 法律用语；post bail 为缴纳保释金。

Definition (EN): to fail a course
Quote from Episode: You flunked me.
台词翻译: 你挂了我的课。
Example Sentence: He flunked chemistry twice.
例句翻译: 他化学挂过两次。
Usage Note: 非正式；正式用 fail。

Definition (EN): a mask protecting the lungs from fumes
Quote from Episode: That's why the respirators.
台词翻译: 所以要戴防毒面具。
Example Sentence: Meth labs require full-face respirators.
例句翻译: 制毒实验室需要全脸防护呼吸器。
Usage Note: 比 mask 专业；动词 respire。

Definition (EN): a person or thing that saves you from a bad situation
Quote from Episode: You are a life saver.
台词翻译: 你真是救了我一命。
Example Sentence: The spare tyre was a real life saver.
例句翻译: 那个备胎真是救了命。
Usage Note: 口语。life-saver 也指救生圈，字面双关。

Definition (EN): respect and admiration
Quote from Episode: Hey, mad props.
台词翻译: 嘿，真服了你。
Example Sentence: Mad props to you for covering for me.
例句翻译: 替我圆场这份情我记下了。
Usage Note: 1990年代黑人俚语，props 是 proper 的变音；年轻人多用 shout-out。

Definition (EN): a stupid, clumsy move
Quote from Episode: which is a bonehead maneuver
台词翻译: 那是个蠢到家了的操作。
Example Sentence: Reading the map while driving is a bonehead maneuver.
例句翻译: 开车时看地图是很蠢的行为。
Usage Note: bonehead=笨蛋，美式口语；英式更常说 daft。

Definition (EN): remain optimistic and not dwell on problems
Quote from Episode: We're just gonna stay positive, right?
台词翻译: 我们就往好处想，对吧？
Example Sentence: Stay positive; the interview went better than you think.
例句翻译: 往好处想，那次面试比你以为的好。
Usage Note: 此处是心理安慰，不是数学上的「保持为正」。

Definition (EN): to stop being connected and go on alone
Quote from Episode: we will go our separate ways
台词翻译: 我们就此分道扬镳。
Example Sentence: The two brothers went their separate ways after the lawsuit.
例句翻译: 打完官司后兄弟俩就分道扬镳了。
Usage Note: 也作 go your separate ways。强调彻底切断关系。

Definition (EN): to feel or show the same way about something, more strongly
Quote from Episode: That goes double for me.
台词翻译: 我也正想说这个。
Example Sentence: If you hate that film, it goes double for me.
例句翻译: 你要是讨厌那部电影，我更讨厌。
Usage Note: 口语，指感受完全一致；常用 It goes double for me 表示强烈赞同或反感。

Definition (EN): unfinished matters needing attention
Quote from Episode: We got loose ends here!
台词翻译: 我们这边还有尾巴没处理！
Example Sentence: A few loose ends before we sign off.
例句翻译: 签字之前还有几件收尾的事。
Usage Note: 固定用复数。tie up loose ends=收尾；at loose ends=茫然无措。

Definition (EN): to say you are ill and will not come to work or school
Quote from Episode: Ditch it, man, call in sick.
台词翻译: 别去了，请个病假。
Example Sentence: He called in sick and went to the beach instead.
例句翻译: 他请了病假，结果去了海滩。
Usage Note: 搭配 call in sick / call in sick leave。名词 sick leave=病假。

Definition (EN): to refuse or reject something
Quote from Episode: has to go through all these photos and turn them down
台词翻译: 得把这些照片全过一遍并退回去。
Example Sentence: The committee turned down our proposal again.
例句翻译: 委员会又一次否决了我们的提案。
Usage Note: 也指调低音量 turn it down；此处是被拒绝。

Definition (EN): a bra
Quote from Episode: some new type of brassiere, or something
台词翻译: 说是出了种新型胸罩什么的。
Example Sentence: Brassiere sizing changed for the first time in decades.
例句翻译: 胸罩尺码几十年来第一次改变。
Usage Note: 美式拼 brassiere(不重音 re)，英式 bra 更常用；是 school health 教材里的正式词。

Definition (EN): to listen closely to something
Quote from Episode: I went and put my ear to the RV
台词翻译: 我凑到房车那儿听了听。
Example Sentence: She put her ear to the door and listened.
例句翻译: 她把耳朵贴到门上听着。
Usage Note: put your ear to something＝凑近听；ear to the ground＝倾听消息。

Definition (EN): to escape from confinement
Quote from Episode: I think he's trying to get loose.
台词翻译: 我觉得他在试图挣脱。
Example Sentence: The horse got loose and bolted.
例句翻译: 马挣脱了缰绳跑了。
Usage Note: 此义指挣脱束缚；lose/loose 一字之差。

Definition (EN): to panic or become very agitated
Quote from Episode: I'm freaking out over here!
台词翻译: 我这边快急疯了！
Example Sentence: Don't freak out, it's only a scratch.
例句翻译: 别慌，只是一道划痕。
Usage Note: 比 panic 程度低；freak someone out=吓到某人。

Definition (EN): to spring suddenly on a target
Quote from Episode: waiting to pounce!
台词翻译: 等着猛扑过来！
Example Sentence: The cat pounced on the mouse.
例句翻译: 猫猛地扑向老鼠。
Usage Note: 字面猫扑 prey；引申为抓住时机突袭。

Definition (EN): to wait patiently for the right moment
Quote from Episode: I would just lie back down, and bide my time.
台词翻译: 我就重新躺下，耐心等时机。
Example Sentence: He bided his time until the right moment.
例句翻译: 他耐心等待合适的时机。
Usage Note: 正式/书面；bide one's time 与 wait one's turn 不同，指等待良机。

Definition (EN): completely unconscious
Quote from Episode: Because he was out cold.
台词翻译: 因为他当时昏死过去了。
Example Sentence: The boxer left his opponent out cold.
例句翻译: 拳击手把对手打得昏了过去。
Usage Note: 只用于失去意识，不能用于睡着（asleep）。knock out cold 更强。

Definition (EN): requires action now
Quote from Episode: This isn't even the issue that demands immediate attention
台词翻译: 这甚至都不是那个需要马上处理的问题。
Example Sentence: The leak demands immediate attention.
例句翻译: 泄漏问题必须立刻处理。
Usage Note: 书面语；demand 作动词时「要求」用复数 demands 表示单数主语。

Definition (EN): behaviour considered impolite or wrong
Quote from Episode: I don't suppose it is bad form to just flip a coin
台词翻译: 抛硬币决定大概不算失礼吧。
Example Sentence: It was bad form to leave without saying goodbye.
例句翻译: 不告而别很失礼。
Usage Note: 英式较常见；it is bad form to do sth＝做某事有失体面。

Definition (EN): weak and easily broken; unconvincing
释义（中文）: 薄而不结实的；站不住脚的
Quote from Episode: this feels kind of flimsy
台词翻译: 这塑料摸起来挺不结实。
Example Sentence: That's a flimsy excuse and we both know it.
例句翻译: 那个借口很站不住脚，我们俩都清楚。
Usage Note: 既形容物理脆弱，也形容论点/借口无力。 flimsy alibi=站不住脚的不在场证明。

Definition (EN): to eat away at something until it is destroyed
Quote from Episode: Any decent acid's gonna eat right through this.
台词翻译: 随便什么像样的酸都能把这腐蚀穿。
Example Sentence: Rust ate through the pipe in a year.
例句翻译: 锈一年内就把管子蛀穿了。
Usage Note: 此处是被强酸穿透；eat into＝逐渐侵蚀。

Definition (EN): to be needlessly unpleasant about a refusal
释义（中文）: 因为被拒绝就摆臭脸；小气
Quote from Episode: Be a dick about it.
台词翻译: 那你就小气去吧。
Example Sentence: Don't be a dick about it, it was a mistake.
例句翻译: 别为这点事摆脸色，那是失误。
Usage Note: 粗俗但常用；dick=混蛋，与生理义无关。名词 a dick=讨厌的人。

Definition (EN): to gradually bring yourself to do something unpleasant
释义（中文）: 鼓起勇气去做（不想做的事）
Quote from Episode: I'm working up to it.
台词翻译: 我正在鼓起勇气去做。
Example Sentence: He worked up to asking for a raise.
例句翻译: 他鼓起勇气去要求加薪。
Usage Note: 强调心理上的逐步准备；work up the courage to do sth 同义。

Definition (EN): someone exhausted and disengaged from their usual life
Quote from Episode: this big secret you seem to be discussing with some druggie burn-out
台词翻译: 你在跟一个嗑药的废物讨论什么大秘密。
Example Sentence: The company is full of quiet burn-outs.
例句翻译: 公司里到处都是 quietly 倦怠的人。
Usage Note: burnout=职业倦怠(不可数)；a burn-out 指人(可数)。

Definition (EN): to make sense; to be the logical result
Quote from Episode: the whole thing adds up to
台词翻译: 这么看整件事就说得通了。
Example Sentence: The numbers don't add up to a real motive.
例句翻译: 这些数字凑不出一个真实的动机。
Usage Note: add up to 还有「总计」义；此处指讲得通。

Definition (EN): short by an amount
Quote from Episode: % shy.
台词翻译: 还差 %。
Example Sentence: We're two hundred dollars shy of the target.
例句翻译: 我们离目标还差两百块。
Usage Note: shy of=差…；此处接数字，与害羞无关。

Definition (EN): the raised arch of the foot
Quote from Episode: My arches happen to be extremely archy.
台词翻译: 我的脚弓那叫一个厉害。
Example Sentence: Flat feet mean the arches do not support you.
例句翻译: 扁平足意味着足弓无法支撑身体。
Usage Note: 原文是俏皮话 extremely archy（在 arches 上玩梗），可学的词只有 arches。

Definition (EN): to stop and reconsider before continuing
Quote from Episode: let me back up.
台词翻译: 我重新说一下。
Example Sentence: Let me back up and start again.
例句翻译: 我打住重头说一遍。
Usage Note: 口语：讲着讲着修正自己；backup a plan=另做打算。

Definition (EN): used to swear that something is true
Quote from Episode: Right hand to God, Walter Jr.
台词翻译: 我对天发誓，小沃尔特他……
Example Sentence: Right hand to God, I didn't take it.
例句翻译: 我对天发誓，不是我拿的。
Usage Note: 较老式的强调语；现在多说 I swear to God。

Word / Phrase: not as far as I know
Definition (EN): based on the little information I have
Quote from Episode: Certainly not as far as I know.
台词翻译: 至少据我所知不是。
Example Sentence: He never lies, not as far as I know.
例句翻译: 据我所知他从不撒谎。
Usage Note: as far as I know 是日常限定的固定说法，暗示自己并不完全确定。

Definition (EN): humiliating; losing one's dignity
Quote from Episode: This is degrading.
台词翻译: 这太有辱人格了。
Example Sentence: He considers the uniform degrading.
例句翻译: 他觉得穿那身制服有失身份。
Usage Note: 既指人格受辱，也指物理磨损；动词 degrade。

Definition (EN): a surprising piece of news
Quote from Episode: This shouldn't come across as some news flash.
台词翻译: 这不该算什么劲爆消息吧。
Example Sentence: Don't treat my leaving like a news flash.
例句翻译: 别把我走当成什么大新闻。
Usage Note: 源自广播新闻快讯；作「这没什么大不了」时带贬义。

Definition (EN): killing without any emotion or mercy
Quote from Episode: if it's between that and cold-blooded murder
台词翻译: 如果非要在放我和冷血谋杀之间选。
Example Sentence: He was convicted of cold-blooded murder.
例句翻译: 他被判冷血谋杀罪。
Usage Note: 固定搭配；warm-blooded 形容词指「热血的」，与之相反。

Definition (EN): to defecate
Quote from Episode: I'm trying to pinch one off in here!
台词翻译: 我正打算在这儿拉一个呢！
Example Sentence: Tell him I'm pinching one off, then talk to me.
例句翻译: 就说我在拉屎，然后让他来找我。
Usage Note: 极粗俗；pinch/squeeze/take a crap 同义，正式场合完全不能用。

Definition (EN): to stop a flow by squeezing it shut
Quote from Episode: pinch one off
台词翻译: 拉一个
Example Sentence: Pinch the hose off and let the tank drain.
例句翻译: 捏住软管让水箱排空。
Usage Note: 此处字面掐断管子，Jesse 借的双关；pinch off a valve 是机械术语。

Word / Phrase: this is going down the toilet
Definition (EN): is being wasted or destroyed
Quote from Episode: This is going down the toilet.
台词翻译: 这下全进马桶里了。
Example Sentence: Another week like that and we're going down the toilet.
例句翻译: 再来一周这样我们厂就完了。
Usage Note: down the toilet 是习语，泛指彻底报废、浪费。

Definition (EN): to be what someone has managed to achieve
Quote from Episode: That is your contribution?
台词翻译: 那就是你的贡献？
Example Sentence: A four-hour cleanup. That is your contribution.
例句翻译: 收拾了四个小时。就这？
Usage Note: 反讽用法：字面是「贡献」，实则指糟糕的结果。

Definition (EN): the smell of sweaty feet
Quote from Episode: My whole house smells like toe cheese and dry cleaning.
台词翻译: 我整间屋子都是脚臭味和干洗店味。
Example Sentence: The gym smells like toe cheese.
例句翻译: 健身房闻起来像脚臭。
Usage Note: toe cheese=脚趾间真菌感染的俗称；也指闻起来像奶酪的脚。

Definition (EN): declare a random tie-breaker binding
释义（中文）: 抛硬币的结果神圣不可违
Quote from Episode: Coin flip is sacred.
台词翻译: 抛硬币神圣不可侵犯。
Example Sentence: We agreed. Coin flip is sacred. Now go.
例句翻译: 说好了。抛硬币神圣，现在去干活。
Usage Note: sacred 意为不可侵犯；呼应 Walt 用抛硬币推卸责任的诡辩。

Definition (EN): to steal their clients
Quote from Episode: he'd end up snaking their customers
台词翻译: 最后他总是把他们的客户撬走。
Example Sentence: The new hire spent a year poaching accounts from the old team.
例句翻译: 那个新人一整年从老团队挖客户。
Usage Note: 动词 snake 本义蛇行，引申为暗中抢夺（客户/人才）。

Definition (EN): to inform on someone
Quote from Episode: Last guy he ratted out was none other than his cousin
台词翻译: 他最后一个告发的人偏偏是他表哥。
Example Sentence: He ratted out his own supplier to save himself.
例句翻译: 他为了自保把供货商卖了。
Usage Note: rat＝卑劣小人／告密者。近义 squeal、inform on。

Definition (EN): officially assumed to have died
Quote from Episode: It turns out he's missing, presumed dead.
台词翻译: 结果是他人间蒸发，被列为推定死亡。
Example Sentence: The case has been closed as presumed dead since March.
例句翻译: 案子自三月起按推定死亡结案了。
Usage Note: 法律/公文用语。presume＝推定。missing presumed dead 是固定搭配。

Definition (EN): very impressed or amazed
Quote from Episode: Our chemist was blown away.
台词翻译: 我们那位化学家惊得说不出话。
Example Sentence: She was blown away by the sample purity.
例句翻译: 那份样本的纯度让她大吃一惊。
Usage Note: 被动式＝被震住。反义 blown off（被敷衍）。

Definition (EN): a large high-end clandestine laboratory
释义（中文）: 超级实验室（大型隐秘实验室）
Quote from Episode: it didn't come out of some superlab in Mexico
台词翻译: 这可不是从墨西哥哪个超级实验室出来的。
Example Sentence: The trace suggested a domestic superlab, not an import.
例句翻译: 痕迹指向本土的超级实验室，不是进口货。
Usage Note: super- 前缀表示规模极大。犯罪语境专用。

Definition (EN): a place where drugs are manufactured
Quote from Episode: Car was abandoned at what appears to be a cook site.
台词翻译: 车被丢在一个看起来是制毒窝点的地方。
Example Sentence: Investigators found a cook site behind the warehouse.
例句翻译: 调查人员在仓库后面发现了一个制毒窝点。
Usage Note: cook 作动词＝制毒。fixed 住所叫 stash house / safe house。

Definition (EN): to be warned that you are being watched
Quote from Episode: So be on notice.
台词翻译: 所以你们给我当心点。
Example Sentence: Rivals were put on notice after the price war.
例句翻译: 价格战之后对手们都收到了警告。
Usage Note: 警告语气。put someone on notice／serve notice。

Word / Phrase: burn the shit out of someone
Definition (EN): to attack or outperform them fiercely
Quote from Episode: you're burning the shit out of them
台词翻译: 你这是往死里揍他们。
Example Sentence: Their team has been burning the hell out of the competition.
例句翻译: 他们队把对手打得毫无还手之力。
Usage Note: 非常粗俗。也可说 beat the shit out of（揍）。

Definition (EN): appearing one after another
Quote from Episode: Girls gotta be lining up left and right.
台词翻译: 姑娘们肯定排着队往这儿涌。
Example Sentence: Offers were lining up left and right by Friday.
例句翻译: 到周五各种邀约已经纷至沓来。
Usage Note: 字面「左右排开」。也作 coming out of the woodwork。

Definition (EN): how a woman would view the situation
Quote from Episode: That's a female perspective.
台词翻译: 这就是所谓的女性视角。
Example Sentence: He asks a male client to check it with a female perspective.
例句翻译: 他让男客户拿「女性视角」再掂量一下。
Usage Note: 职场谈体验/评审时常用。近义 consumer's eye。

Definition (EN): to keep asking them for it
Quote from Episode: I kept bugging her for a date.
台词翻译: 我一直在缠着她要约会。
Example Sentence: He bugged accounting for the numbers for a week.
例句翻译: 他缠着会计要数据要了一星期。
Usage Note: bug 作动词＝纠缠、烦。名词 a bug＝纠缠。

Definition (EN): to make a regulation stricter
Quote from Episode: It was before they tightened the stalking laws.
台词翻译: 那还是他们收紧跟踪骚扰法之前。
Example Sentence: Regulators tightened the law on influencer disclosure.
例句翻译: 监管机构收紧了网红广告披露的法规。
Usage Note: tighten up on sth＝加强。名词 tightening。

Definition (EN): all over the place
Quote from Episode: I chased your Aunt Marie here all over creation.
台词翻译: 我当时满城追你玛丽姨妈。
Example Sentence: He's been all over creation looking for the receipt.
例句翻译: 他满世界找那张收据。
Usage Note: 老式口语＝everywhere。近义 all over the shop（满店都是）。

Definition (EN): to decide firmly that you will get it
Quote from Episode: Once you set your cap for something, or somebody
台词翻译: 一旦你盯上了什么东西或者什么人。
Example Sentence: She set her cap on the managing director role.
例句翻译: 她打定主意要拿下总经理的位子。
Usage Note: 19世纪戏服「向某人求婚」。语气执着，有时含轻蔑。

Definition (EN): to be capable of achieving it
Quote from Episode: I'll bet you didn't think your old man had it in him
台词翻译: 我敢说你没觉得你老子有这本事。
Example Sentence: He's slow but he has it in him.
例句翻译: 他慢，但他有那个能力。
Usage Note: 谈能力/毅力。相似 have what it takes。

Definition (EN): continued effort despite difficulty
Quote from Episode: Confidence and and persistence.
台词翻译: 自信，加上坚持。
Example Sentence: Persistence beat talent in the end.
例句翻译: 最后是坚持打败了天赋。
Usage Note: 形容词 persistent；动词 persist in＝坚持做。反义 give up。注意原文引文里 and 重复了两次，是字幕转写重复，不是你的重点。

Definition (EN): to realise what is really happening
Quote from Episode: And once I caught on to that
台词翻译: 等我察觉到这一点之后……
Example Sentence: It took him a month to catch on to the pricing change.
例句翻译: 他花了一个月才察觉调价了。
Usage Note: get the hang of＝掌握窍门；catch on＝想明白。

Definition (EN): to escape punishment
Quote from Episode: How do they think they can get away with this?
台词翻译: 他们以为这样就能蒙混过关？
Example Sentence: He got away with it because nobody checked.
例句翻译: 因为没人核查，他蒙混过去了。
Usage Note: 后接 it／sth。get away with murder 是习语（逍遥法外）。

Definition (EN): advice from another specialist
Quote from Episode: Certainly a second opinion, right?
台词翻译: 肯定要找个专家再看一次，对吧？
Example Sentence: Always get a second opinion before surgery.
例句翻译: 手术前一定要找第二个医生看看。
Usage Note: 医疗通用；也用于「再听听别人的意见」。

Definition (EN): the branch of medicine dealing with cancer
Quote from Episode: we find you the best the oncology dream team
台词翻译: 我们给你找最好的肿瘤科梦之队。
Example Sentence: She moved into oncology after a fellowship.
例句翻译: 她做完研究员的培训后转去做肿瘤了。
Usage Note: 形容词 oncological。发音「昂-科勒-吉」。

Definition (EN): to be so obvious it need not be stated
释义（中文）: 不言而喻；不用说也知道
Quote from Episode: I hope this goes without saying
台词翻译: 这件事我想不用我说了吧。
Example Sentence: That he lied goes without saying.
例句翻译: 他撒谎了，这一点不言而喻。
Usage Note: 正式。反义 it needs saying。

Definition (EN): excellent, impressive
Quote from Episode: These are mad tight.
台词翻译: 这些真是顶呱呱。
Example Sentence: His new album is mad tight.
例句翻译: 他的新专辑牛得不行。
Usage Note: 俚语（黑人英语），年轻人常用。反义 mad trash。

Definition (EN): you are the one suffering from refusing
释义（中文）: 那是你不领情／是你的损失
Quote from Episode: Your loss.
台词翻译: 那是你不识货。
Example Sentence: They passed on the offer? Their loss.
例句翻译: 他们没接那个offer？那是他们亏了。
Usage Note: 轻蔑或调侃。也可指真正的「损失」。

Definition (EN): collapsing inward
Quote from Episode: It's been caving in left and right.
台词翻译: 房子到处都在塌。
Example Sentence: The retaining wall started caving in after the rain.
例句翻译: 雨后挡土墙开始往里塌。
Usage Note: 建筑/地质描述。反义 bulge out（鼓出去）。

Definition (EN): to pay to release them from custody
Quote from Episode: His cousin bailed him out.
台词翻译: 是他表哥交保释金把他弄出来的。
Example Sentence: His parents had to bail him out twice.
例句翻译: 他父母两次花钱把他保出来。
Usage Note: 名词 bail＝保释金。也可指财务上替人解围。

Definition (EN): to flee one's home city
Quote from Episode: He skipped town or something.
台词翻译: 他好像是跑路了什么的。
Example Sentence: He skipped town the day the audit landed.
例句翻译: 审计下来的当天他就跑了。
Usage Note: take to the hills 属同义俚语。名词 a skip town。

Definition (EN): to act independently
Quote from Episode: I've been kinda doing my own thing these days
台词翻译: 我最近算是自己单干了。
Example Sentence: After the split she just did her own thing.
例句翻译: 拆伙以后她就自己干了。
Usage Note: 非常常用。近义 go it alone。

Definition (EN): to want to use some drugs
Quote from Episode: I could seriously go for a bowl.
台词翻译: 我是真想来一口。
Example Sentence: After the week I had, I could really go for a bowl.
例句翻译: 熬过这一周，我是真想来一口。
Usage Note: 俚语。bowl＝一管／一炉的量。反义 pass（在下一集用过了）。

Definition (EN): to reduce anxiety or urgency
Quote from Episode: Take the edge off.
台词翻译: 缓一缓吧。
Example Sentence: A walk took some of the edge off.
例句翻译: 散了会儿步，火气消了些。
Usage Note: edge＝紧张感／锐度。take the edge off＝让…不那么紧绷。

Definition (EN): to stop using or doing something
Quote from Episode: I'll just lay off of it for a while.
台词翻译: 我先停一阵子。
Example Sentence: He laid off the stimulants after the diagnosis.
例句翻译: 确诊之后他把兴奋剂停了。
Usage Note: 职场义＝裁员。药瘾语境＝戒断，此处是前者混淆但都常见。

Definition (EN): to tell someone to go away
Quote from Episode: just tell us to piss off
台词翻译: 你就直说让我们滚蛋不就完了。
Example Sentence: If you don't want to share, just piss off.
例句翻译: 你要是不想分享，那就别来烦我们。
Usage Note: 粗俗。名词 piss-off＝让人恼火的人。

Definition (EN): a melodramatic personal saga
释义（中文）: 狗血剧情；家长里短的闹剧
Quote from Episode: We don't need no soap opera.
台词翻译: 我们不要搞这套狗血剧情。
Example Sentence: The board didn't sign up for a soap opera.
例句翻译: 董事会可不想要一场狗血大戏。
Usage Note: 引申义与字面（肥皂剧）差距很大，职场指情绪化的纠缠。

Definition (EN): to squeeze them into a busy schedule
Quote from Episode: Thank you so much for working us in.
台词翻译: 太感谢您挤时间安排我们了。
Example Sentence: Can you work us in on Thursday?
例句翻译: 周四能给我们挤个时间吗？
Usage Note: 常指医院/美发/服务行业把客人插进空档。反义 squeeze in。

Definition (EN): to help them when it mattered
释义（中文）: 帮了大忙；关键时刻顶上
Quote from Episode: Marie really came through for us.
台词翻译: 玛丽真是帮了我们大忙。
Example Sentence: She came through for the team on the last deal.
例句翻译: 最后一单她替团队顶了下来。
Usage Note: 近义 pull through（挺过去）；come through＝最终成功。

Definition (EN): starting now
Quote from Episode: From here on out, things are gonna
台词翻译: 从今往后，事情会……
Example Sentence: From here on out we brief in writing.
例句翻译: 从现在起我们都用书面同步。
Usage Note: ≈ from now on。正式度高于 going forward。

Definition (EN): under official supervision after a conviction
Quote from Episode: Because I'm on probation, yo.
台词翻译: 因为我在缓刑期，老兄。
Example Sentence: Convicted fraud suspects usually serve probation.
例句翻译: 判了欺诈的一般都是缓刑。
Usage Note: 刑法律语；也指员工试用/察看期 probation period。

Definition (EN): restored to good standing after wrongdoing
释义（中文）: 已改过自新的；被改造好的
Quote from Episode: Gotta prove to the man I'm rehabilitated.
台词翻译: 我得让法官相信我已经改好了。
Example Sentence: He finished rehab and now counts as rehabilitated.
例句翻译: 他做完了戒毒疗程，现在算改过自新了。
Usage Note: 形容词 rehabilitated；名词 rehabilitation。法律＋医疗两义。

Definition (EN): a morally respectable member of society
Quote from Episode: Upstanding citizen.
台词翻译: 守法公民。
Example Sentence: His record made him an upstanding citizen again.
例句翻译: 履历干净，他又成了守法公民。
Usage Note: upstanding＝正直的。常反讽用，指表现得太正经。

Definition (EN): to be very difficult to do
Quote from Episode: That one's a bitch.
台词翻译: 那个动作可难了。
Example Sentence: That last part of the route is a bitch.
例句翻译: 最后那段路可难走了。
Usage Note: 粗俗但极常用。名词 a bitch＝难缠的事／难对付的人。

Definition (EN): to make you realise something is possible
Quote from Episode: you really opened my eyes to the possibilities
台词翻译: 你真是让我看到了各种可能性。
Example Sentence: That trip opened my eyes to how much I had been missing.
例句翻译: 那趟旅行让我意识到自己错过了多少。
Usage Note: 固定搭配。＝开眼界。反义 close your eyes to。

Definition (EN): to connect you with what you need
Quote from Episode: I can hook you up with some pseudo.
台词翻译: 我能帮你弄到点伪麻黄碱。
Example Sentence: Can you hook me up with a decent contractor?
例句翻译: 你能给我推荐个靠谱的装修队吗？
Usage Note: 职场常用。hook up 还有「勾搭上」义，看语境。

Word / Phrase: wouldn't miss it for the world
Definition (EN): absolutely would attend
Quote from Episode: Wouldn't miss it for the world.
台词翻译: 这种场合我绝不会缺席。
Example Sentence: I wouldn't miss the all-hands for anything.
例句翻译: 全员会我肯定到场。
Usage Note: 强表态。＝for the world 也可作 for anything（无论如何）。

Definition (EN): emphasising the first quality over the second
释义（中文）: （怀）孕太显了，相比之下美不美就…了
Quote from Episode: these days a little more big than beautiful
台词翻译: 这几天比起好看来更像胖了。
Example Sentence: Right now she's more tired than cheerful.
例句翻译: 她现在是累多过开心。
Usage Note: 这是婉转说法：不好直说某状态。＝rather than。

Definition (EN): to be naturally drawn to
Quote from Episode: I gravitated toward education.
台词翻译: 我自然就往教育这条路上走了。
Example Sentence: He gravitated toward research rather than sales.
例句翻译: 他自然倾向做研究而不是销售。
Usage Note: gravitate to＝受吸引。名词 gravitation。

Definition (EN): out of practice; no longer sharp
Quote from Episode: You're a little rusty, but you're not seeing the upside here.
台词翻译: 你是有点生疏了，但你看不出这事的价值。
Example Sentence: My C is rusty. I'd have to look up the basics.
例句翻译: 我 C 语言荒废了，基础都得现查。
Usage Note: 字义是生锈的。引申技能退步。反义 sharp。

Definition (EN): the beneficial side of something
Quote from Episode: you're not seeing the upside here
台词翻译: 你看不到这件事的好处。
Example Sentence: The downside is the cost; the upside is the data.
例句翻译: 代价是花钱，好处是拿到数据。
Usage Note: 反义 the downside（弊端）。upsides and downsides 很常见。

Definition (EN): inability to see alternatives
Quote from Episode: You get tunnel vision.
台词翻译: 你就会钻进牛角尖里出不来。
Example Sentence: Months on one problem gave her tunnel vision.
例句翻译: 在一个问题上耗了几个月，她就钻牛角尖了。
Usage Note: 也指生理上的视野狭窄。职场批评常用。

Definition (EN): to consider unconventional approaches
释义（中文）: 跳出框框思考；打破常规
Quote from Episode: One guy thinking outside of the box
台词翻译: 就差一个跳出框框想问题的人。
Example Sentence: Hiring him would get them thinking outside the box.
例句翻译: 招他进来能让他们跳出框框想问题。
Usage Note: 源自玩具「外盒思考」，创新/招聘高频。

Definition (EN): a thin excuse to cover something embarrassing
Quote from Episode: Kind of like some fig leaf, you know?
台词翻译: 有点像一块遮羞布。
Example Sentence: The donation was a fig leaf for the tax bill.
例句翻译: 那笔捐款是用来遮税单的。
Usage Note: 源自《创世纪》中亚当夏娃用无花果叶遮羞。

Definition (EN): allowing someone to avoid embarrassment
释义（中文）: 保全面子的；下得了台的
Quote from Episode: Some face-saving bullshit that allowed me to generously accept his charity
台词翻译: 那是给我留面子的鬼话，让我好意思收下他的施舍。
Example Sentence: They offered him a lateral move as a face-saving gesture.
例句翻译: 他们给他一个平级调岗，算是保全面子。
Usage Note: save face＝保全面子（面子）；lose face＝丢脸。英式更常用。

Definition (EN): to reduce to the essentials
Quote from Episode: When it came right down to it, I didn't know what else to do but tell him the truth.
台词翻译: 真到那份上，我除了说实话没别的办法。
Example Sentence: It comes down to cost per unit, not total spend.
例句翻译: 归根结底是单位成本，不是总花费。
Usage Note: it comes down to X＝关键就是 X。也作 boil down to。

Definition (EN): bluntly and without softening
Quote from Episode: he flat-out offered to pay for my treatment
台词翻译: 他直接提出要付我的治疗费。
Example Sentence: She flat-out refused the transfer.
例句翻译: 她当场就拒绝了调岗。
Usage Note: flat-out lie／refuse＝赤裸裸的。也可作 flatly。

Word / Phrase: talk your way out of something
Definition (EN): to escape a consequence by talking
Quote from Episode: I could've talked my way out of it.
台词翻译: 我本来能靠说辞躲过去的。
Example Sentence: He talked his way out of the speeding ticket.
例句翻译: 他靠狡辩躲掉了超速罚单。
Usage Note: talk one's way into/out of sth。搭配 talk someone out of。

Definition (EN): to hold them accountable afterwards
Quote from Episode: I'll deal with you later.
台词翻译: 回头我再跟你算。
Example Sentence: Let it go now; I'll deal with it tomorrow.
例句翻译: 先算了，我明天再处理。
Usage Note: threat 或拖延义。deal with＝处理、应付。

Definition (EN): minor problems of a new venture or teenager
Quote from Episode: Just growing pains.
台词翻译: 就是长大的烦恼而已。
Example Sentence: Early churn is normal growing pains.
例句翻译: 早期流失属于正常的成长烦恼。
Usage Note: 原指身体发育痛。创业/育儿/青春期通用。

Definition (EN): to obtain or procure it
Quote from Episode: Just a teenager trying to score some beer
台词翻译: 就是个想弄到啤酒的 teenager。
Example Sentence: Can you score us a taxi from here?
例句翻译: 你能从这儿帮我们叫到车吗？
Usage Note: 美式口语。＝get。score 也指得分／刮掉。

Definition (EN): six bottles or cans bought together
Quote from Episode: buy us a six-pack
台词翻译: 帮我们买六罐。
Example Sentence: He grabbed a six-pack and a twenty on the way home.
例句翻译: 他路上买了一提六罐和一包二十支。
Usage Note: a case（一整箱）≈ a twenty-four or thirty. 美式说 pack，英式说 pack of six。

Definition (EN): to get a lucky break
Quote from Episode: Guess you win the jackpot.
台词翻译: 算你走运吧。
Example Sentence: First interview and they hired him — he won the jackpot.
例句翻译: 第一次面试就被录了，他真是走运。
Usage Note: 反讽：其实是走了狗屎运。jackpot 原指老虎机 jackpot。

Definition (EN): to be competent and knowledgeable
Quote from Episode: You really know your shit.
台词翻译: 你还真懂行。
Example Sentence: He knows his shit when it comes to logistics.
例句翻译: 物流这块他很在行。
Usage Note: 粗俗但常作称赞。know what you're doing 同类。

Definition (EN): items made of glass, especially lab or tableware
Quote from Episode: I used to have, like, twice as much glassware
台词翻译: 我以前玻璃器皿有现在两倍多。
Example Sentence: The lab lost half its glassware in the move.
例句翻译: 搬迁时实验室丢了一半玻璃器皿。
Usage Note: 不可数。ware 作后缀＝器皿（software／hardware）。

Definition (EN): to crash off the road into a ditch
Quote from Episode: my dumbass ex-partner drove us into a ditch
台词翻译: 我那个蠢前搭档把车开进了沟里。
Example Sentence: He spun out and drove into a ditch.
例句翻译: 他打滑失控开进了沟。
Usage Note: drive someone into a ditch 也可引申为「毁了某人计划」。

Definition (EN): a long passionate speech
Quote from Episode: All you had to do was mention the Bunsen burner and he was off on a rant.
台词翻译: 你只要一提本生灯，他就开始滔滔不绝。
Example Sentence: She went on a rant about the new expense policy.
例句翻译: 她对新报销制度发了一通牢骚。
Usage Note: go off on a rant／rant about。derail a rant＝打断。

Definition (EN): looking refined and dignified
Quote from Episode: because he thought it made him look more distinguished
台词翻译: 因为他觉得那样显得更有气派。
Example Sentence: The crest made the blazer look properly distinguished.
例句翻译: 有了徽章，这件西装外套才显得够体面。
Usage Note: 形容外表/举止有身份感。动词 distinguish＝区分。

Definition (EN): the essential thing that keeps something going
Quote from Episode: This was our lifeblood.
台词翻译: 这就是我们的命根子。
Example Sentence: Cheap freight is the lifeblood of the model.
例句翻译: 低成本物流是这个模式的命脉。
Usage Note: 通常不加 a：the lifeblood of。＝命脉所在。

Definition (EN): to make illegal or forbid officially
Quote from Episode: I thought they'd been outlawed years ago
台词翻译: 我以为几年前就被取缔了。
Example Sentence: The state outlawed the practice in 2019.
例句翻译: 该州 2019 年取缔了这一做法。
Usage Note: 动词＝宣布非法；名词 outlaw＝逃犯。outlawed 形容词。

Definition (EN): an expression giving nothing away
Quote from Episode: I don't have the best poker face these days
台词翻译: 我最近这张脸藏不住事了。
Example Sentence: She kept a poker face through the whole interview.
例句翻译: 整场面试她都面无表情。
Usage Note: 源自打牌不露牌。keep a poker face＝不动声色。

Definition (EN): to insistently ask them
Quote from Episode: He knew something was wrong with you and he pressed me.
台词翻译: 他知道你不对劲，就追着我问。
Example Sentence: She pressed him for a straight answer.
例句翻译: 她逼他给个明确答复。
Usage Note: 职场追问＝施压。press for details／press someone on sth。

Definition (EN): the only warning you will get
释义（中文）: 最后一次警告；下不为例
Quote from Episode: Consider this your first and last warning.
台词翻译: 就算你第一次警告，也是最后一次。
Example Sentence: She gave him his first and last warning in front of the team.
例句翻译: 她在全组面前给了他最后一次警告。
Usage Note: warn someone off／give someone a final warning。语气很硬。

Definition (EN): to have the resources to act
Quote from Episode: We're in business.
台词翻译: 咱们有得搞了。
Example Sentence: With two investors in, they're in business.
例句翻译: 有两个投资人进场，他们就有的做了。
Usage Note: ≠「营业中」。字面是「有资本/门路」。

Definition (EN): to be in contact
Quote from Episode: have you been in touch with Elliott?
台词翻译: 你和 Elliott 还有联系吗？
Example Sentence: Keep in touch with me after the handover.
例句翻译: 交接完以后跟我保持联系。
Usage Note: 职场/关系高频。get in touch with＝联系上。

Definition (EN): to put money into an account
Quote from Episode: Could you not deposit this until Monday?
台词翻译: 这张支票能不能先别存到周一？
Example Sentence: She deposited the cheque the morning the rent was due.
例句翻译: 房租到期那天早上她才去存的支票。
Usage Note: 英式拼 cheque／deposit，美式 check。名词 a deposit ＝订金/押金。

Definition (EN): a feeling of slight pain or unease
Quote from Episode: Call if the discomfort's too much.
台词翻译: 要是不舒服得受不了就打给我。
Example Sentence: The side effects cause discomfort rather than pain.
例句翻译: 副作用带来的是不适而不是疼痛。
Usage Note: discomfort／discomforting／discomforted。搭配 at ease 的反义。

Definition (EN): a process where substances combine and change
Quote from Episode: Explosions are the result of chemical reactions happening almost instantaneously.
台词翻译: 爆炸是化学反应几乎瞬间发生的结果。
Example Sentence: The reaction releases heat and changes the colour.
例句翻译: 这个反应会放热并改变颜色。
Usage Note: 动词 react；名词 reactant（反应物）／product（产物）。

Definition (EN): in an instant
Quote from Episode: chemical reactions happening almost instantaneously
台词翻译: 几乎瞬间就发生的化学反应
Example Sentence: The two compounds react instantaneously on contact.
例句翻译: 这两种化合物一接触就瞬间反应。
Usage Note: 形容词 instantaneous。≈ in an instant。

Definition (EN): to keep secret or not reveal
Quote from Episode: is there anything else you're holding back from your family?
台词翻译: 你是不是还有什么瞒着家里？
Example Sentence: He held back the numbers until the audit was done.
例句翻译: 他把数字瞒到审计结束才说。
Usage Note: hold sth back＝藏着不说；hold someone back＝拖住某人。

Definition (EN): to stop shutting them out emotionally
释义（中文）: 让某人进入你的世界；对某人敞开心扉
Quote from Episode: Walt when you don't let me in
台词翻译: Walt，你把我关在门外的时候……
Example Sentence: Managers who don't let people in lose their best staff.
例句翻译: 不让人敞开心扉的管理者会失去最好的员工。
Usage Note: 情感义。in 用于关系，into 用于场合（let you into the team）。

Definition (EN): to have no information and be kept guessing
Quote from Episode: we're just left wondering where you are
台词翻译: 我们只能干等着猜你在哪儿。
Example Sentence: Supporters were left wondering whether the site would ever return.
例句翻译: 支持者只能等着，不知道网站还会不会回来。
Usage Note: be left + V-ing＝被动地处在某种处境。

Definition (EN): having a healing or calming effect
释义（中文）: 有疗愈作用的；让人放松的
Quote from Episode: It's really very therapeutic.
台词翻译: 这真的很有治愈感。
Example Sentence: Gardening turned out to be unexpectedly therapeutic.
例句翻译: 园艺意外地很治愈。
Usage Note: 名词 therapy／therapist。口语也指「像在做治疗一样」。

Definition (EN): feeling very hot, often with fever
Quote from Episode: I'm burning up.
台词翻译: 我烧得厉害。
Example Sentence: He was burning up by the time the ambulance arrived.
例句翻译: 救护车到的时候他已经烧得很厉害了。
Usage Note: 发烧说法。＝ have a fever。也可指「着火了」。

Definition (EN): to look extremely pale and haggard
释义（中文）: 脸色苍白憔悴（像刚从微波炉里爬出来）
Quote from Episode: looks like you just crawled out of a microwave.
台词翻译: 你看起来就像刚从微波炉里爬出来。
Example Sentence: After three red-eyes he looked like he crawled out of a microwave.
例句翻译: 连熬三个通宵后他憔悴得不行。
Usage Note: 美式俚语。同类：look like death warmed over。

Definition (EN): to die
Quote from Episode: You want to make some cash for your people before you check out.
台词翻译: 你是在想着趁还在的时候给家里留点钱。
Example Sentence: He paid off the house before his father checked out.
例句翻译: 他在父亲去世前把房贷还清了。
Usage Note: 极委婉说法。更正式的 euphemism 是 pass away。

Definition (EN): a small organ that filters lymph
Quote from Episode: Gone to your lymph nodes.
台词翻译: 已经扩散到你的淋巴结了。
Example Sentence: Stage two means it has reached the lymph nodes.
例句翻译: 二期意味着已经扩散到淋巴结。
Usage Note: 复数 lymph nodes。淋巴系统，癌症分期关键指标。

Definition (EN): a phase of a disease's development
Quote from Episode: What stage are you?
台词翻译: 你这是几期？
Example Sentence: It was caught at stage one, which is why the outlook is good.
例句翻译: 是一期发现的，所以预后还不错。
Usage Note: 医学义＝分期；通用义＝阶段。stage I/II/III/IV。

Definition (EN): chemotherapy
Quote from Episode: The next time, put an ice pack on your head during chemo.
台词翻译: 下次化疗的时候头上敷个冰袋。
Example Sentence: He did six rounds of chemo and kept working.
例句翻译: 他做了六个疗程的化疗，还一直在上班。
Usage Note: 口语缩写，正式 chemotherapy。＝ chemo treatment／chemo session。

Definition (EN): to complete a set of work done in one run
Quote from Episode: You going to be able to finish the batch?
台词翻译: 这批你做得完吗？
Example Sentence: We have to finish the batch before the shift ends.
例句翻译: 这批必须在下班前做完。
Usage Note: batch＝一批；生产/后厨/实验室通用。

Definition (EN): a lot of money
Quote from Episode: I'm out there making fat stacks, man.
台词翻译: 我在外面赚着大把钞票呢，老兄。
Example Sentence: He's making fat stacks on the used-car lot.
例句翻译: 他在二手车行赚得盆满钵满。
Usage Note: 俚语。a stack ＝一叠（通常 1000 美元）。

Definition (EN): to sell drugs, especially to buyers
Quote from Episode: I've been out there all night slinging crystal.
台词翻译: 我整晚在外面兜售冰毒。
Example Sentence: He got busted for slinging weed out of his apartment.
例句翻译: 他因为在公寓里卖大麻被抓。
Usage Note: 名词 a slinger＝毒贩。同义 peddle、deal。

Definition (EN): an amount of drugs large enough to trigger a felony charge
Quote from Episode: but would you be interested in a felony quantity of methamphetamine?
台词翻译: 但你对大量冰毒有兴趣吗？
Example Sentence: He was arrested with a felony quantity of cocaine.
例句翻译: 他被查到持有大量可卡因，按重罪起诉。
Usage Note: 美国法律分级：misdemeanor（轻罪）／felony（重罪）。

Definition (EN): near the top of a hierarchy
Quote from Episode: look, he's upper level, man.
台词翻译: 你看，他是大人物，老兄。
Example Sentence: Only upper-level staff see the full financial data.
例句翻译: 只有高层员工能看到完整的财务数据。
Usage Note: 职场层级：entry-level／mid-level／upper-level／executive。

Definition (EN): to deal or trade with them
Quote from Episode: He's not going to do business with some dude he doesn't know.
台词翻译: 他不会跟一个他不认识的人做生意。
Example Sentence: We don't do business with anyone under forty.
例句翻译: 我们不跟四十岁以下的人做生意。
Usage Note: 常见搭配：do business with／in。＝ have dealings with。

Definition (EN): to approach someone forcefully with no introduction
Quote from Episode: You can't just bum rush some high-level ice man and start cutting deals, okay?
台词翻译: 你不能直接硬闯去找一个大毒枭谈交易，明白吗？
Example Sentence: Don't bum rush the CFO — get an introduction first.
例句翻译: 别硬闯 CFO 的办公室，先找个人引荐。
Usage Note: 职场也有：别一上来就找老板硬谈。

Definition (EN): to negotiate and agree terms
释义（中文）: 谈成一笔交易；达成协议
Quote from Episode: We got a deal.
台词翻译: 成交。
Example Sentence: They cut a deal that kept both vendors alive.
例句翻译: 他们谈成了一笔让两家供应商都活下来的协议。
Usage Note: 职场超高频。＝ strike／close a deal（签成）。

Definition (EN): to be introduced to someone useful
Quote from Episode: You need an intro.
台词翻译: 你需要一个引荐。
Example Sentence: Can you get me an intro to the head of design?
例句翻译: 你能帮我引荐一下设计负责人吗？
Usage Note: intro 是 introduction 的口语缩写。＝ warm introduction。

Definition (EN): to speak in support of their character
Quote from Episode: You need someone to vouch.
台词翻译: 你得有人替你说句话。
Example Sentence: Will your former manager vouch for you?
例句翻译: 你以前的经理愿意替你作保吗？
Usage Note: ＝ back／endorse。vouch for sth 也可作「保证某事属实」。

Definition (EN): in serious trouble
Quote from Episode: the last thing I want to do is get you in hot water
台词翻译: 我最不想做的就是把你牵扯进麻烦里。
Example Sentence: Two junior analysts got in hot water over the same spreadsheet.
例句翻译: 两个初级分析师因为同一份表格惹上了麻烦。
Usage Note: 同义 in a tight spot、in trouble。get in hot water＝惹祸。

Definition (EN): a wild scramble for something
Quote from Episode: some meth monkey had a feeding frenzy in here
台词翻译: 有个瘾君子在这儿翻箱倒柜翻疯了
Example Sentence: Reporters went into a feeding frenzy when the story broke.
例句翻译: 消息一出记者们立刻扑上去抢新闻。
Usage Note: 原义动物抢食。＝ frenzy 狂热；frantic 疯狂的。

Definition (EN): to watch something or someone closely
Quote from Episode: You got to keep a better watch over your turf.
台词翻译: 你得把自己的地盘看紧点。
Example Sentence: Someone needs to keep a watch over the loading bay at night.
例句翻译: 晚上得有人盯着装货区。
Usage Note: keep watch on／over。turf＝地盘（俚语）。

Definition (EN): to be on close friendly terms
Quote from Episode: you're sure you're tight with this guy?
台词翻译: 你确定你跟这家伙关系很好？
Example Sentence: He grew tight with the warehouse crew.
例句翻译: 他跟仓库那帮人混得很熟。
Usage Note: tight with＝关系近。tight with cash＝抠门。

Definition (EN): a really nice place
Quote from Episode: Sick crib, yo.
台词翻译: 这房子真带劲，老兄。
Example Sentence: His new crib has a rooftop deck.
例句翻译: 他新住处有屋顶露台。
Usage Note: 俚语。crib＝住处／房间。＝ dope／sick／ill。

Definition (EN): being honest and not pretending
Quote from Episode: You been keeping it real since you been sprung.
台词翻译: 你出来之后一直挺本分的。
Example Sentence: I appreciate that you keep it real with me.
例句翻译: 我很感谢你跟我说实话。
Usage Note: 口语。＝ being real、straight with me。

Definition (EN): released from custody
Quote from Episode: since you been sprung
台词翻译: 自从你被放出来
Example Sentence: He was sprung two weeks after the arrest.
例句翻译: 被捕两周后他就被放出来了。
Usage Note: slang。反义 locked up。也可作 spring 跳出。

Definition (EN): to start a conversation in an awkward situation
Quote from Episode: Break out the ice.
台词翻译: 来，share 一点。
Example Sentence: He opened with a joke to break the ice.
例句翻译: 他用一句玩笑破冰。
Usage Note: 源自破冰航行。职场社交/谈判开场必备。

Definition (EN): selling goods on behalf of a supplier
Quote from Episode: This is a consignment operation.
台词翻译: 我们这是寄售的生意。
Example Sentence: Consignment means the retailer only gets paid after the item sells.
例句翻译: 寄售意味着零售商要等货卖出去才拿钱。
Usage Note: ＝ consignment wholesale。寄售 vs 买断（buyout）。

Definition (EN): to provide money upfront and hope to recover it
Quote from Episode: You want me to float 35 G's?
台词翻译: 你要我先垫三万五？
Example Sentence: The vendor floated payroll until the invoice cleared.
例句翻译: 供应商先垫发了工资，等发票回款。
Usage Note: 职场财务义＝垫付。float income ＝非固定收入。

Definition (EN): paying immediately before delivery
Quote from Episode: Cash up front.
台词翻译: 现钱，一手交钱。
Example Sentence: Their policy is 50% cash up front and 50% on delivery.
例句翻译: 他们的政策是一半预付一半交货时付。
Usage Note: 职场/贸易。up front＝事先；预先。

Word / Phrase: I have two words for you
Definition (EN): my whole answer in one phrase
释义（中文）: 我给你两句话就说完了
Quote from Episode: I got two words for you: background check.
台词翻译: 我给你两句话：背景调查。
Example Sentence: Had I two words for you: read the contract.
例句翻译: 我给你两句话：把合同读完。
Usage Note: 口语，强调答案极短。＝ long story short。

Definition (EN): that is just how I operate
释义（中文）: 我就是这么混的／这就是我的路数
Quote from Episode: because that's how I roll
台词翻译: 因为我就这德行
Example Sentence: I take the long way — that's how I roll.
例句翻译: 我就爱绕远路，这就是我的风格。
Usage Note: roll＝风格、路子。同类：that's just the way it is。

Definition (EN): to match a description of the suspect
Quote from Episode: Fit the profile.
台词翻译: 完全符合画像。
Example Sentence: His background fits the profile we drew up.
例句翻译: 他的背景符合我们梳理出来的画像。
Usage Note: 职场也常用：fits the profile for the role＝符合这个岗位的画像。

Definition (EN): official permission to search a place
Quote from Episode: we got a search warrant, and we tore old Hugo's house apart
台词翻译: 我们拿到了搜查令，把 Hugo 家翻了个底朝天
Example Sentence: They cannot enter without a search warrant.
例句翻译: 没有搜查令他们不能进去。
Usage Note: arrive vs execute a warrant。同类 warrant＝授权令。

Definition (EN): to search it thoroughly and messily
Quote from Episode: we tore old Hugo's house apart
台词翻译: 我们把 Hugo 家翻了个底朝天
Example Sentence: Auditors tore the books apart looking for the gap.
例句翻译: 审计为了找账目缺口把账翻了个遍。
Usage Note: tear apart 也可指「拆解分析」，＝ break down。

Definition (EN): a habitual cannabis user
Quote from Episode: Turns out he's a major league pothead.
台词翻译: 结果他是个十足的大麻鬼。
Example Sentence: major league pothead ＝ 严重的大麻瘾者
例句翻译: （例句同上）
Usage Note: 俚语。major league＝「严重的/顶级的」，职场也用（major league screw-up＝天大的失误）。

Definition (EN): to give someone a particular impression
释义（中文）: 给人的感觉是；让人觉得
Quote from Episode: Hugo just doesn't strike me as the thief.
台词翻译: Hugo 给我完全不像小偷的感觉。
Example Sentence: Her pitch struck me as too polished to be true.
例句翻译: 她的提案给我的感觉是打磨过头，不像是真的。
Usage Note: it strikes me（that）＝ 我觉得。形容词的近义：come across as。

Definition (EN): to get past checks that should have caught it
释义（中文）: 从缝隙里漏过去；被蒙混过关
Quote from Episode: How could something like that just slip through the cracks?
台词翻译: 这种事怎么能就这么漏过去呢？
Example Sentence: A contractor with an expired licence slipped through the checks.
例句翻译: 一个执照过期的承包商混过了审查。
Usage Note: 职场质量管理高频。＝ fall between the cracks。

Definition (EN): as a minor concession of value
释义（中文）: 说句公道话；不过怎么说呢
Quote from Episode: I mean, for what it's worth
台词翻译: 怎么说呢，参考一下
Example Sentence: For what it's worth, I read the whole document.
例句翻译: 说句公道话，整份文件我看了。
Usage Note: 缓冲语。也可作 for what it is（就其价值而言）。

Definition (EN): unlawfully entering a building
Quote from Episode: there is no sign of breaking or entering
台词翻译: 没有任何非法闯入的痕迹
Example Sentence: He was charged with breaking and entering a school.
例句翻译: 他被控闯入一所学校。
Usage Note: 刑事罪名（重罪）。动词 break in / break into。

Definition (EN): a crime committed by someone with access
释义（中文）: 内鬼干的；有权限的人作案
Quote from Episode: We're talking inside job?
台词翻译: 你是说内鬼干的？
Example Sentence: The data breach was almost certainly an inside job.
例句翻译: 这次数据泄露几乎肯定是内部人干的。
Usage Note: 职场也用：the departure was an inside job＝离职是内斗的结果。

Definition (EN): deliberately ambiguous or contradictory statements
Quote from Episode: But that sounds like double-talk.
台词翻译: 但这听起来就是含糊其辞。
Example Sentence: His answer was classic double-talk — technically true, practically useless.
例句翻译: 他那回答是典型的两面话——字面成立，实际没用。
Usage Note: 政治/公关高频。＝ weasel words（含糊其辞的措辞）。

Definition (EN): to stop hedging and tell them the truth
释义（中文）: 跟某人说实话；别兜圈子
Quote from Episode: You have to level with us.
台词翻译: 你得跟我们说实话。
Example Sentence: Leadership needs to level with staff about the delays.
例句翻译: 管理层必须就延期一事对员工坦诚。
Usage Note: ＝ be honest with someone。副词 on the level＝坦率。

Definition (EN): a trained dog that detects drugs
Quote from Episode: what I'd like to see in this school? Drug-sniffing dogs.
台词翻译: 我在这个学校想看到什么？缉毒犬。
Example Sentence: A drug-sniffing dog flagged the luggage at customs.
例句翻译: 一只缉毒犬在海关查出了那件行李。
Usage Note: sniff＝嗅；K-9 是警犬的委婉说法。

Definition (EN): the body that runs all the public schools in an area
Quote from Episode: Our district has strict policies
台词翻译: 我们学区有严格的规定
Example Sentence: The district raised the average class size again.
例句翻译: 学区又扩大了平均班额。
Usage Note: 美国教育体系核心概念。district 校区／区议会／区经理。

Definition (EN): a worker who maintains outdoor areas
Quote from Episode: They arrested one of their groundskeepers with drugs.
台词翻译: 他们把一个场地管理员因为毒品抓了。
Example Sentence: A retired groundskeeper now handles the grounds full time.
例句翻译: 一个退休的场地维护工现在全职管这块地。
Usage Note: 美式用 groundskeeper，英式常叫 caretaker／groundskeeper。

Definition (EN): to be under the influence of a drug
Quote from Episode: over half of the students were high on LSD
台词翻译: 一半以上的学生都处在 LSD 的药效里
Example Sentence: Most of the class was high on something at lunchtime.
例句翻译: 中午班上大半人都飘着。
Usage Note: 职场黑话：high on caffeine＝咖啡因上头；high on confidence＝自信爆棚。

Definition (EN): time off work because of illness
Quote from Episode: White is currently on medical leave.
台词翻译: White 先生目前在休病假。
Example Sentence: She's been on medical leave since March.
例句翻译: 她从三月起就在休病假。
Usage Note: 职场正式说法。＝ sick leave（英式更常用）。

Definition (EN): the glass and equipment used in a laboratory
Quote from Episode: The inventory list for the missing labware
台词翻译: 失踪实验器材的清单如下
Example Sentence: All the labware has to be logged out before you leave.
例句翻译: 所有实验器材离开前都要登记。
Usage Note: 不可数。细分：glassware 玻璃器皿／hardware 器材。

Definition (EN): a glass vessel for separating immiscible liquids
Quote from Episode: some sep funnels
台词翻译: 几个分液漏斗
Example Sentence: Separate the layers with a separatory funnel, not by pouring.
例句翻译: 用分液漏斗分层，别直接倒。
Usage Note: 字幕省略成 sep funnels。同类 round-bottom flask 圆底烧瓶。

Definition (EN): to focus attention on one target
Quote from Episode: We're zeroing in.
台词翻译: 我们正在锁定目标。
Example Sentence: The auditors zeroed in on the year-end entries.
例句翻译: 审计把注意力集中到了年末分录上。
Usage Note: 职场/侦探通用。＝ focus on、home in on。

Definition (EN): only if you have arranged a time in advance
Quote from Episode: It's by appointment only.
台词翻译: 本处仅限预约。
Example Sentence: The clinic is by appointment only, no walk-ins.
例句翻译: 诊所仅限预约，不接受直接来诊。
Usage Note: 服务业高频。walk-in＝免预约的客人。

Definition (EN): ready to fight or compete fiercely
Quote from Episode: Acting like you were all out for blood.
台词翻译: 一副要跟你拼命的架势。
Example Sentence: Both teams came out all out for blood from the first whistle.
例句翻译: 两队从开场哨响就是拼命的架势。
Usage Note: ＝ go all out。名词 all-out effort。

Definition (EN): to stop behaving foolishly
Quote from Episode: You are alive, so obviously you wised up.
台词翻译: 你还活着，显然是想明白了。
Example Sentence: They didn't wise up until the second audit.
例句翻译: 直到第二次审计他们才学乖。
Usage Note: get wise to／wise someone up。否定 wise up＝学聪明点。

Definition (EN): to reach a mutual informal agreement
Quote from Episode: We came to an understanding.
台词翻译: 我们达成了共识。
Example Sentence: The two sides came to an understanding without a formal contract.
例句翻译: 双方没签正式合同就达成了共识。
Usage Note: 正式度低于 reach an agreement。＝ come to terms（更常用于谈判）。

Definition (EN): to increase in size or volume
Quote from Episode: We'll just scale up our operation.
台词翻译: 我们把生意规模扩大就是了。
Example Sentence: They scaled up hiring before validating the product.
例句翻译: 产品还没验证他们就扩大了招聘。
Usage Note: 职场核心词。反义 scale down。scale up production／scale up a team。

Definition (EN): a courier who buys small legal quantities and resells
释义（中文）: 「小蓝」——按小剂量代购处方药再转卖的人
Quote from Episode: to meet up with my smurfs
台词翻译: 去跟我的「小蓝」们接头
Example Sentence: They moved the supply chain onto a network of smurfs.
例句翻译: 他们把供应链改成了靠一群「小蓝」运转。
Usage Note: 源自漫画《蓝精灵》。合规等义＝ 分包（subcontracting）。

Definition (EN): the single point that limits the whole process
Quote from Episode: that's the bottleneck in your brilliant business plan
台词翻译: 这就是你那份天才商业计划里的瓶颈。
Example Sentence: Approvals are the bottleneck in our release process.
例句翻译: 审批是我们发布流程的瓶颈。
Usage Note: 职场高频。bottleneck＝瓶颈；去掉＝ unbottleneck。

Definition (EN): a party held before a baby is born
Quote from Episode: The baby shower's next week.
台词翻译: 迎婴派对在下周。
Example Sentence: Her baby shower is on the Saturday.
例句翻译: 她的迎婴派对在周六。
Usage Note: 美式习俗：产前办 shower，产后办 sip-and-see。

Definition (EN): to walk with a short, wide, unsteady gait
Quote from Episode: waddling to the bathroom every five minutes
台词翻译: 每五分钟就歪歪扭扭地跑去趟厕所
Example Sentence: The duck waddled across the yard.
例句翻译: 那只鸭子摇摇摆摆地穿过院子。
Usage Note: 名词 waddle。鸭子的标准步态动词。

Definition (EN): a drug that prevents vomiting
Quote from Episode: we've got the anti-emetics tuned right
台词翻译: 说明止吐药我们已经调好了
Example Sentence: The anti-emetics handle the nausea but not the fatigue.
例句翻译: 止吐药管恶心，但管不了疲劳。
Usage Note: 前缀 anti- ＝ 抗／反。emesis＝呕吐（医学拉丁）。

Definition (EN): a scan that shows how the body is using energy
释义（中文）: PET 正电子发射断层扫描
Quote from Episode: we look at a new PET scan
台词翻译: 我们再做一次 PET 扫描看看
Example Sentence: The new PET scan showed no signs of spread.
例句翻译: 新的 PET 扫描没有显示扩散迹象。
Usage Note: PET＝positron emission tomography。与 MRI、CT 并列的影像检查。

Definition (EN): treating the whole person, not just symptoms
Quote from Episode: You know, holistic.
台词翻译: 就是那种「整体疗法」。
Example Sentence: A holistic view of wellbeing covers sleep, diet and workload.
例句翻译: 整体的健康观涵盖睡眠、饮食和工作量。
Usage Note: holistic health／holistic approach。holism＝整体论。

Definition (EN): the power to produce a desired effect
Quote from Episode: I can't speak to its efficacy.
台词翻译: 疗效我不能置评。
Example Sentence: The trial showed no measurable efficacy.
例句翻译: 试验没有显示出可测量的疗效。
Usage Note: 医学/药物标准词。adj. efficacious＝有效的。近义 effectiveness。

Definition (EN): acceptable to me
Quote from Episode: is fine by me
台词翻译: 我这边没意见。
Example Sentence: Friday at four? That's fine by me.
例句翻译: 周五四点？我没问题。
Usage Note: 职场确认句。＝ OK by me。

Definition (EN): to set realistic expectations in advance
Quote from Episode: it's also important that we manage our expectations
台词翻译: 另外，管理好我们的预期也很重要。
Example Sentence: Set expectations before the kickoff, not after.
例句翻译: 预期要在启动前设定好，而不是事后。
Usage Note: 职场/商务高频。under／lower expectations＝调低预期。

Definition (EN): to carry out dealings
Quote from Episode: So where do you transact your business?
台词翻译: 那你都在哪儿做交易？
Example Sentence: All legal business must be transacted through the registered agent.
例句翻译: 所有正式业务都必须通过注册代理人办理。
Usage Note: 正式书面语，≈ do business。更常见 transact with。

Definition (EN): to inform or explain clearly
Quote from Episode: Enlighten me.
台词翻译: 你给我讲讲。
Example Sentence: Could you enlighten me on how the split works?
例句翻译: 拆分是怎么算的，能给我讲明白吗？
Usage Note: 形容词 enlightening＝有启发性的（会议反馈常用）。

Definition (EN): a deal is completed at a certain place
Quote from Episode: Half the deals I've ever done went down at Taco Cabeza.
台词翻译: 我做过的一半交易都是在 Taco Cabeza 谈成的。
Example Sentence: The biggest financing in our history went down over lunch.
例句翻译: 我们历史上最大的一笔融资是在一顿午饭时谈成的。
Usage Note: go down ＝ 完成、谈成（deal／contract）。

Definition (EN): to beat them up
Quote from Episode: I'm sorry that I had to tune you up.
台词翻译: 抱歉我把你揍了。
Example Sentence: Two guys tuned him up outside the club.
例句翻译: 两个家伙在俱乐部外面把他揍了。
Usage Note: 粗俗俚语。tune＝揍、收拾。

Word / Phrase: You gotta give it to get it
Phonetic (IPA): /juː ˌɡɑːtə ˈɡɪv ɪt tə ˈɡet ɪt/
Definition (EN): nothing comes without effort
Quote from Episode: You gotta give it to get it.
台词翻译: 想拿东西就得先给。
Example Sentence: Networking is slow, but you gotta give it to get it.
例句翻译: 人脉见效慢，但你得先付出。
Usage Note: 谚语式。职场版：you have to invest to get returns。

Definition (EN): someone with real standing and influence
Quote from Episode: I thought you was a player.
台词翻译: 我还以为你是个有分量的人。
Example Sentence: She proved to be a player in the industry within a year.
例句翻译: 一年之内她就证明了自己是这行里的狠角色。
Usage Note: 职场有褒义（能人）和贬义（玩权术的人）两读，看语境。

Definition (EN): money put in to make a return
Quote from Episode: Consider it a capital investment.
台词翻译: 就当是前期投资吧。
Example Sentence: Treat the training as a capital investment in the team.
例句翻译: 把培训当成对团队的投资。
Usage Note: 职场常用。注意 capex（资本支出）／opex（运营支出）。

Definition (EN): to be difficult to obtain
Quote from Episode: they're hard to come by
台词翻译: 这种很难弄到
Example Sentence: Senior engineers with that background are hard to come by.
例句翻译: 有那种背景的高级工程师很难招到。
Usage Note: 反义 widely available。＝ rare and difficult to obtain。

Definition (EN): exclude me; I am not taking part
Quote from Episode: Count me out.
台词翻译: 算我一个……算了，我退出。
Example Sentence: Count me out of that meeting — nothing there concerns me.
例句翻译: 那个会就别叫我了，跟我无关。
Usage Note: 反义 count me in（算我一个）。

Word / Phrase: the first day of the rest of your life
Phonetic (IPA): /ðə ˈfɜːrst deɪ əv ðə ˈrest əv jʊr laɪf/
Definition (EN): a dramatic way to mark a turning point
Quote from Episode: Today is the first day of the rest of your life.
台词翻译: 今天是你余生的第一天。
Example Sentence: Quitting corporate law was the first day of the rest of her life.
例句翻译: 辞掉公司律师的工作是她余生的第一天。
Usage Note: 戒烟/戒酒宣传的经典口号。也作 best day of your life。

Definition (EN): a unit of gemstone weight
Quote from Episode: several carats' worth of zircons
台词翻译: 值好几个克拉的锆石
Example Sentence: The setting is 24-carat gold, but the stones are cubic zirconia.
例句翻译: 托是 24K 金的，但石头是立方氧化锆。
Usage Note: 1 carat＝0.2 克。british 金衡 24 ct＝纯金。

Definition (EN): something tempting but not allowed
Quote from Episode: sometimes forbidden fruit tastes the sweetest
台词翻译: 有时候禁果尝起来最甜
Example Sentence: The parking spot was forbidden fruit for the whole department.
例句翻译: 那个车位对全部门来说都是只能干看的禁果。
Usage Note: 源自《圣经》伊甸园。注意别和 Adam's apple 搞混。

Definition (EN): where we decide the boundary is acceptable
Quote from Episode: How we draw that line.
台词翻译: 我们怎么划这条线。
Example Sentence: That's a policy decision — it determines how we draw that line.
例句翻译: 这是政策决定——它决定我们这条线划在哪儿。
Usage Note: 职场谈合规/边界时很有用。draw the line at／on。

Definition (EN): based on whim, not on a reason
Quote from Episode: I'm just saying it's arbitrary.
台词翻译: 我只是说这很随意。
Example Sentence: The distinction between the two tiers feels arbitrary.
例句翻译: 两个等级之间的划分感觉毫无道理。
Usage Note: ＝ random。arbitrarily 副词。critique 常用。

Definition (EN): a jail holding area
Quote from Episode: you ought to visit lockup
台词翻译: 你真该去拘留所看看
Example Sentence: He spent eighteen months in lockup before trial.
例句翻译: 审判前他在拘留所待了十八个月。
Usage Note: jail＝看守所；prison ＝监狱（判决后）。也可作动词＝锁起来。

Definition (EN): to stop behaving foolishly
Quote from Episode: they came to their senses on that one
台词翻译: 在这个问题上他们总算清醒了
Example Sentence: The market came to its senses after two years of froth.
例句翻译: 市场在两年泡沫后终于清醒了。
Usage Note: 反义 in one's senses＝神志清醒。

Definition (EN): to be certain to do it
Quote from Episode: She's bound to find out.
台词翻译: 她肯定会发现的。
Example Sentence: If you leave the file open, someone is bound to ask.
例句翻译: 文件开着，总会有人来问的。
Usage Note: be bound to 也可指「受制于」（bound by a contract）。

Definition (EN): it has some merit after all
Quote from Episode: maybe there is something to it
台词翻译: 也许还是有点道理的
Example Sentence: I was sceptical, but there's something to his argument.
例句翻译: 我本来不信，但他的论证有点东西。
Usage Note: 半信半疑的说法。反义 there's nothing to it。

Definition (EN): a small enclosed structure for a ritual steam bath
释义（中文）: 汗屋（仪式用的蒸汗小屋）
Quote from Episode: They do this Navajo sweat lodge up by Farmington.
台词翻译: 他们在 Farmington 那边办这种纳瓦霍汗屋仪式。
Example Sentence: The sweat lodge ceremony runs from dawn to midnight.
例句翻译: 汗屋仪式从清晨一直持续到午夜。
Usage Note: 北美原住民传统。in the same boat 之类习语的来源地之一。

Definition (EN): to encounter a problem
Quote from Episode: that's where I ran into some trouble
台词翻译: 我就是在那儿遇到了麻烦
Example Sentence: Most vendors run into trouble at the customs step.
例句翻译: 多数供应商都是在清关这一步出问题。
Usage Note: trouble 不可数。run into＝偶遇/碰上（人）。

Definition (EN): under very strict control
Quote from Episode: They got it locked down tight.
台词翻译: 他们把那东西管得死紧。
Example Sentence: Finance locked down tight on travel spend in March.
例句翻译: 财务部三月起把差旅开支管得很死。
Usage Note: 职场描述管控。lock down＝封锁／管制。

Definition (EN): to steal it
Quote from Episode: I did find some pros who will rip it off for us.
台词翻译: 我确实找到了几个能帮我们把它偷出来的行家。
Example Sentence: They ripped off the warehouse inventory over a weekend.
例句翻译: 他们一个周末就把仓库库存偷走了。
Usage Note: rip off 也有「宰客／骗钱」（rip someone off）。

Definition (EN): a thick bundle of banknotes
Quote from Episode: I already spent almost the whole wad.
台词翻译: 我已经花掉差不多整叠了。
Example Sentence: He paid the deposit in cash, a thick wad of it.
例句翻译: 他用现金付的定金，厚厚一叠。
Usage Note: 俚语。a wad of bills／money。

Definition (EN): an alloy that burns at extreme heat to cut metal
Quote from Episode: So what's this stuff called again? Thermite.
台词翻译: 这玩意儿叫什么来着？铝热剂。
Example Sentence: They cut the gate with a thermite charge.
例句翻译: 他们用铝热剂烧开了那道门。
Usage Note: 铝＋金属氧化物的混合物，反应温度可达约 2500°C，焊轨/破门用。写作 thermite 或 thermit。

Definition (EN): to be able to do it
Quote from Episode: capable of firing a 7-ton shell
台词翻译: 有能力发射七吨重的炮弹
Example Sentence: The team is capable of shipping this in two weeks.
例句翻译: 团队有能力两周内交付。
Usage Note: ＝ be able to（更正式）。inability 反义。

Definition (EN): to bring a criminal prosecution against someone
Quote from Episode: I intend to press charges.
台词翻译: 我打算报警。
Example Sentence: The retailer pressed charges once the serial number came back.
例句翻译: 序列号查回来之后商家就报了警。
Usage Note: press charges against someone。drop charges＝撤诉。

Definition (EN): no evidence whatsoever
Quote from Episode: without a shred, without a modicum of evidence
台词翻译: 没有一丝一毫、一点点的证据
Example Sentence: There's not a shred of evidence the deal was above board.
例句翻译: 没有任何证据表明这笔交易是干净的。
Usage Note: a shred＝一丝（不可数）。shred of doubt／a shred of hope。

Definition (EN): a small amount of
Quote from Episode: without a shred, without a modicum of evidence
台词翻译: 没有一丝、一点点的证据
Example Sentence: Show a modicum of discipline and the rest follows.
例句翻译: 拿出一点自律，其他的自然跟上。
Usage Note: 正式词，多用于否定。＝ a degree of、a certain amount of。

Definition (EN): to hold someone against their will
Quote from Episode: illegally detained an innocent pregnant woman
台词翻译: 非法拘留了一个无辜的孕妇
Example Sentence: They detained him for questioning but released him in an hour.
例句翻译: 他们把他留下来问话，一小时后就放了。
Usage Note: detainer＝拘留令。＝ hold up。职场礼貌用法：detained＝耽搁。

Definition (EN): to be kept against your will
Quote from Episode: I feel I'm being held hostage.
台词翻译: 我觉得自己像是被扣押了。
Example Sentence: Junior staff feel held hostage by the approval process.
例句翻译: 基层员工觉得被审批流程困住了。
Usage Note: 字面为人质；引申为被流程/强势方拿捏。

Definition (EN): to begin childbirth
Quote from Episode: I'm going into labor.
台词翻译: 我要生了。
Example Sentence: Her water broke at 34 weeks and she went into labor early.
例句翻译: 她 34 周就破水早产了。
Usage Note: 英式 labour，美式 labor。in labor＝正在分娩。

Definition (EN): to restate a figure in today's money
Quote from Episode: adjusting for inflation say, $45,000 a year
台词翻译: 按通胀折算，一年大概四万五。
Example Sentence: The salary looks impressive until you adjust for inflation.
例句翻译: 按通胀折算后这份薪水就没那么诱人了。
Usage Note: 财经必备；inflation-adjusted real terms＝实际（不变价）口径。

Definition (EN): HELOC: a credit line secured against the house
Quote from Episode: Home equity line, 30,000.
台词翻译: 房屋净值额度，三万。
Example Sentence: They tapped the home equity line to cover the renovation.
例句翻译: 他们动用房屋净值额度付装修款。
Usage Note: 缩写 HELOC。在美国是常见的高息借贷来源。

Definition (EN): a long-term loan secured against property
Quote from Episode: Remaining mortgage on the home
台词翻译: 房子的剩余房贷。
Example Sentence: They paid off the mortgage five years early.
例句翻译: 他们提前五年还清了房贷。
Usage Note: 英式常拼 mortgage，美式同理；动词 mortgage＝抵押。

Definition (EN): the average cost of basic living
Quote from Episode: Cost of living, food, clothing, utilities
台词翻译: 生活开销：吃、穿、水电煤。
Example Sentence: Their offer doesn't cover the cost of living here.
例句翻译: 他们的报价不够覆盖这里的生活成本。
Usage Note: = COL。动词搭配 cost of living index＝生活成本指数。

Definition (EN): water, gas, electricity and similar household services
Quote from Episode: Cost of living, food, clothing, utilities
台词翻译: 生活开销：吃、穿、水电煤。
Example Sentence: The utilities alone run four hundred a month here.
例句翻译: 光水电费这里一个月就要四百。
Usage Note: 永远用复数；单数 utility 指「有用、公用事业」。

Definition (EN): to be beaten up badly
Quote from Episode: You can't take an ass-beating, bitch?
台词翻译: 你挨不起打吗，贱人？
